9798    #[tokio::test]
9799    async fn failed_root_registration_does_not_bind_inherited_input() {
9800        for raw_root in [3, 37] {
9801            let config = Config {
9802                sequentialize_threads: false,
9803                ..Config::default()
9804            }
9805            .with_backend(|backend| backend.tool_shares_guest_descriptor_table = true);
9806            let mut state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
9807            let pipe = reverie::InheritedInput::pipe(0).unwrap();
9808            state.install_inherited_input(pipe.lease().unwrap());
9809            let root = DetTid::from_raw(raw_root);
9810            let root_mm = MmId::initial(root);
9811            let response = state
9812                .recv_create_child_thread(
9813                    Tid::from_raw(raw_root),
9814                    root_mm,
9815                    super::ChildRegistration {
9816                        parent_dettid: root,
9817                        parent_detpid: root,
9818                        child_dettid: root,
9819                        child_tid_addr: 0,
9820                        flags: None,
9821                        exit_signal: libc::SIGCHLD,
9822                        // The real physical-registration boundary rejects
9823                        // nonpositive IDs before opening any kernel pidfd.
9824                        physical_ids: Some((-1, -1)),
9825                        maybe_priority: Some(DEFAULT_PRIORITY),
9826                        parent_is_kernel_blocked: false,
9827                    },
9828                )
9829                .await;
9830            assert!(matches!(response, SchedulerRpcResult::ThreadExited));
9831            let input = state.inherited_input.lock().unwrap();
9832            let input = input
9833                .as_ref()
9834                .expect("failed registration consumed the lease");
9835            assert!(input.root.is_none(), "failed registration bound the root");
9836            assert_eq!(input.lease.identity(), pipe.identity());
9837        }
9838    }

9840    fn cancellation_test_state() -> (Config, GlobalState, DetTid, DetPid) {
9841        let config = Config {
9842            sequentialize_threads: true,
9843            ..Config::default()
9844        }
9845        .with_backend(|backend| {
9846            backend.needs_killed_thread_rpc_cancellation = true;
9847        });
9848        let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
9849        let dettid = DetTid::from_raw(17);
9850        let detpid = DetPid::from_raw(17);
9851        state
9852            .sched
9853            .lock()
9854            .unwrap()
9855            .thread_tree
9856            .add_child(dettid, dettid, true);
9857        // The root inherits its process group from outside the namespace; this
9858        // test's root leads its own, as after setpgid(0, 0).
9859        state
9860            .sched
9861            .lock()
9862            .unwrap()
9863            .thread_tree
9864            .set_process_group(detpid, detpid);
9865        (config, state, dettid, detpid)
9866    }

9868    fn install_test_registration(state: &GlobalState, dettid: DetTid, request: Ivar<SchedRequest>) {
9869        let mut scheduler = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
9870        assert!(!scheduler.thread_is_logically_killed(dettid));
9871        scheduler.next_turns.insert(
9872            dettid,
9873            ThreadNextTurn {
9874                dettid,
9875                child_tid_addr: 0,
9876                req: request,
9877                resp: Ivar::new(),
9878                protocol: Default::default(),
9879            },
9880        );
9881        scheduler.priorities.insert(dettid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
9882        scheduler.runqueue_push_back(dettid);
9883    }

10131    /// While the caller's own process handles SIGALRM, every SIGALRM send and
10132    /// producer arming the handlers check is refused with EPERM before the
10133    /// kernel: the guest injects nothing (`RetirementGuest` panics on an
10134    /// injection) and sends no RPC but the ledger's control message.
10135    #[tokio::test]
10136    async fn sigalrm_sends_and_producer_armings_are_refused_before_the_kernel() {
10137        use reverie::Tool;
10138        use reverie::syscalls;
10139
10140        let (config, state, tid, pid) = cancellation_test_state();
10141        install_test_registration(&state, tid, Ivar::new());
10142        {
10143            let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10144            sched.set_sigalrm_handled(pid, true);
10145            sched.set_running_for_test(tid);
10146        }
10147        let tool: Detcore = Detcore::new(Tid::from_raw(tid.as_raw()), &config);
10148        let mut thread = tool.init_thread_state(Tid::from_raw(tid.as_raw()), None);
10149        thread.detpid = Some(pid);
10150        let mut guest = RetirementGuest {
10151            global: &state,
10152            config: &config,
10153            thread,
10154            requests: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
10155            retired: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
10156        };
10157        let (raw_pid, raw_tid) = (pid.as_raw(), tid.as_raw());
10158        let eperm = |result: Result<i64, reverie::Error>, what: &str| {
10159            assert!(
10160                matches!(result, Err(reverie::Error::Errno(errno)) if errno == reverie::Errno::EPERM),
10161                "{what}: {result:?}"
10162            );
10163        };
10164
10165        let sigalrm = libc::SIGALRM;
10166        let tgkill = syscalls::Tgkill::new()
10167            .with_tgid(raw_pid)
10168            .with_tid(raw_tid)
10169            .with_sig(sigalrm);
10170        eperm(tool.handle_tgkill(&mut guest, tgkill).await, "tgkill");
10171        let tkill = syscalls::Tkill::new().with_tid(raw_tid).with_sig(sigalrm);
10172        eperm(tool.handle_tkill(&mut guest, tkill).await, "tkill");
10173        let kill = syscalls::Kill::new().with_pid(raw_pid).with_sig(sigalrm);
10174        eperm(tool.handle_kill(&mut guest, kill).await, "kill");
10175        let queue = syscalls::RtSigqueueinfo::new()
10176            .with_tgid(raw_pid)
10177            .with_sig(sigalrm);
10178        eperm(
10179            tool.handle_rt_sigqueueinfo(&mut guest, queue).await,
10180            "rt_sigqueueinfo",
10181        );
10182        let tgqueue = syscalls::RtTgsigqueueinfo::new()
10183            .with_tgid(raw_pid)
10184            .with_tid(raw_tid)
10185            .with_sig(sigalrm);
10186        eperm(
10187            tool.handle_rt_tgsigqueueinfo(&mut guest, tgqueue).await,
10188            "rt_tgsigqueueinfo",
10189        );
10190        let pdeathsig = syscalls::Prctl::new()
10191            .with_option(libc::PR_SET_PDEATHSIG)
10192            .with_arg2(sigalrm as libc::c_ulong);
10193        eperm(
10194            tool.handle_prctl(&mut guest, pdeathsig).await,
10195            "PR_SET_PDEATHSIG",
10196        );
10197        // A NULL sigevent names SIGALRM; the id pointer is never written.
10198        let timer = syscalls::TimerCreate::new()
10199            .with_clockid(syscalls::ClockId::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
10200            .with_timerid(reverie::syscalls::AddrMut::from_raw(0x1000));
10201        eperm(
10202            tool.handle_timer_create(&mut guest, timer).await,
10203            "timer_create",
10204        );
10205
10206        let requests = guest.requests.lock().unwrap();
10207        assert_eq!(requests.len(), 7);
10208        assert!(
10209            requests
10210                .iter()
10211                .all(|request| matches!(request, GlobalRequest::Sigalrm(_))),
10212            "{requests:?}"
10213        );
10214    }

10216    /// In a process that handles SIGALRM, signal phase 1's gate refuses what
10217    /// its table does not place, with EOPNOTSUPP, and allows what it places,
10218    /// with no RPC either way.
10219    #[tokio::test]
10220    async fn sigalrm_phase1_gate_refuses_unplaced_calls() {
10221        use reverie::Tool;
10222        use reverie::syscalls::Syscall;
10223        use reverie::syscalls::SyscallArgs;
10224        use reverie::syscalls::Sysno;
10225
10226        let (config, state, tid, pid) = cancellation_test_state();
10227        install_test_registration(&state, tid, Ivar::new());
10228        let tool: Detcore = Detcore::new(Tid::from_raw(tid.as_raw()), &config);
10229        let mut thread = tool.init_thread_state(Tid::from_raw(tid.as_raw()), None);
10230        thread.detpid = Some(pid);
10231        thread.sigalrm_handled = true;
10232        let guest = RetirementGuest {
10233            global: &state,
10234            config: &config,
10235            thread,
10236            requests: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
10237            retired: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
10238        };
10239        let raw = |sysno, a0, a1| Syscall::from_raw(sysno, SyscallArgs::new(a0, a1, 0, 0, 0, 0));
10240
10241        for (sysno, a0, a1) in [
10242            (Sysno::rt_sigsuspend, 0x1000, 8),
10243            (Sysno::signalfd4, usize::MAX, 0x1000),
10244            (Sysno::epoll_pwait2, 3, 0),
10245            (Sysno::nanosleep, 0x1000, 0),
10246            (Sysno::fcntl, 3, libc::F_SETLKW as usize),
10247            (Sysno::execve, 0x1000, 0),
10248            // stdin, and a descriptor Detcore does not model.
10249            (Sysno::read, 0, 0x1000),
10250            (Sysno::read, 77, 0x1000),
10251            // stderr, which may be a socket Detcore labels Regular.
10252            (Sysno::close, 2, 0),
10253            // No ioctl is placed.
10254            (Sysno::ioctl, 1, libc::TCGETS as usize),
10255            // Buffered credentials and native process relations remain outside
10256            // the four scalar identity queries.
10257            (Sysno::getresuid, 0x1000, 0x2000),
10258            (Sysno::getresgid, 0x1000, 0x2000),
10259            (Sysno::getgroups, 1, 0x1000),
10260            (Sysno::getppid, 0, 0),
10261            (Sysno::getpgid, 0, 0),
10262            (Sysno::getsid, 0, 0),
10263        ] {
10264            assert_eq!(
10265                tool.sigalrm_phase1_gate(&guest, raw(sysno, a0, a1)),
10266                Some(nix::errno::Errno::EOPNOTSUPP),
10267                "{sysno}"
10268            );
10269        }
10270        for (sysno, a0, a1) in [
10271            (Sysno::getpid, 0, 0),
10272            (Sysno::write, 1, 0x1000),
10273            (Sysno::getuid, 0, 0),
10274            (Sysno::geteuid, 0, 0),
10275            (Sysno::getgid, 0, 0),
10276            (Sysno::getegid, 0, 0),
10277        ] {
10278            assert_eq!(
10279                tool.sigalrm_phase1_gate(&guest, raw(sysno, a0, a1)),
10280                None,
10281                "{sysno}"
10282            );
10283        }
10284        assert!(guest.requests.lock().unwrap().is_empty(), "no RPC");
10285    }

10287    /// While any process handles SIGALRM, a file lease is refused before the
10288    /// kernel: its break would make another process's open wait with no
10289    /// scheduler admission. Releasing a lease is not refused.
10290    #[tokio::test]
10291    async fn a_file_lease_is_refused_while_a_guest_handles_sigalrm() {
10292        use reverie::Tool;
10293        use reverie::syscalls;
10294        use reverie::syscalls::FcntlCmd;
10295
10296        let (config, state, tid, pid) = cancellation_test_state();
10297        install_test_registration(&state, tid, Ivar::new());
10298        {
10299            let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10300            sched.set_sigalrm_handled(DetPid::from_raw(99), true);
10301            sched.set_running_for_test(tid);
10302        }
10303        let tool: Detcore = Detcore::new(Tid::from_raw(tid.as_raw()), &config);
10304        let mut thread = tool.init_thread_state(Tid::from_raw(tid.as_raw()), None);
10305        thread.detpid = Some(pid);
10306        let mut guest = RetirementGuest {
10307            global: &state,
10308            config: &config,
10309            thread,
10310            requests: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
10311            retired: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
10312        };
10313        for lease in [libc::F_RDLCK, libc::F_WRLCK] {
10314            let fcntl = syscalls::Fcntl::new()
10315                .with_fd(3)
10316                .with_cmd(FcntlCmd::F_SETLEASE(lease));
10317            let result = tool.handle_fcntl(&mut guest, fcntl).await;
10318            assert!(
10319                matches!(result, Err(reverie::Error::Errno(errno)) if errno == reverie::Errno::EPERM),
10320                "{lease}: {result:?}"
10321            );
10322        }
10323        let requests = guest.requests.lock().unwrap();
10324        assert_eq!(requests.len(), 2);
10325        assert!(requests.iter().all(|request| matches!(
10326            request,
10327            GlobalRequest::Sigalrm(super::SigalrmControl::ArmProducer)
10328        )));

10331    /// A committed SIGKILL victim's late ordinary request is never answered
10332    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3994, design revision 4,
10333    /// R1). The two late states are a background operation's rejoin posted
10334    /// after the commit (`BlockedExternalContinue`, through
10335    /// `resource_request`, as `helpers.rs` posts it once the operation's
10336    /// outcome is in) and a plain request. In both, the callback stays
10337    /// pending: no response, no injection (`RetirementGuest` panics on one),
10338    /// and no `retire_current_thread`, so the backend's terminal owner
10339    /// consumes the real death. Its consuming cleanup is still answered.
10340    #[tokio::test]
10341    async fn a_sigkilled_threads_late_ordinary_request_stays_unanswered() {
10342        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
10343
10344        use reverie::Tool;
10345
10346        let config = Config {
10347            sequentialize_threads: true,
10348            ..Config::default()
10349        };
10350        let [root, sender, victim] = [1, 2, 3].map(DetPid::from_raw);
10351        let commit = |state: &GlobalState| {
10352            let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10353            let token = sched.reserve_sigkill(sender, victim, 0).unwrap().token;
10354            assert_eq!(sched.commit_sigkill(token, true).len(), 1);
10355            assert!(sched.is_unaccounted_sigkill_victim(victim));
10356        };
10357        // "filed": the rejoin is admitted and waiting for its turn when the
10358        // commit happens. "rejoin" and "plain" arrive after the commit.
10359        for late in ["filed", "rejoin", "plain"] {
10360            let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
10361            {
10362                let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10363                sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, root, true);
10364                sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, sender, true);
10365                sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, victim, true);
10366            }
10367            for tid in [root, sender, victim] {
10368                install_test_registration(&state, tid, Ivar::new());
10369                state
10370                    .sched
10371                    .lock()
10372                    .unwrap()
10373                    .record_thread_mm(tid, MmId::initial(tid));
10374            }
10375            if late != "filed" {
10376                commit(&state);
10377            }
10378            let tool: Detcore = Detcore::new(Tid::from_raw(victim.as_raw()), &config);
10379            let mut thread = tool.init_thread_state(Tid::from_raw(victim.as_raw()), None);
10380            thread.detpid = Some(victim);
10381            let mut guest = RetirementGuest {
10382                global: &state,
10383                config: &config,
10384                thread,
10385                requests: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
10386                retired: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
10387            };
10388            {
10389                let mut rejoin = Resources::new(victim);
10390                rejoin.insert(
10391                    ResourceID::BlockedExternalContinue(ExternalOpId::new(victim, 7)),
10392                    Permission::RW,
10393                );
10394                let pending = if late == "plain" {
10395                    let mut call = std::pin::pin!(super::send_and_update_time(
10396                        &mut guest,
10397                        GlobalRequest::GlobalTimeLowerBound
10398                    ));
10399                    futures::poll!(call.as_mut()).is_pending()
10400                } else {
10401                    let mut call = std::pin::pin!(super::resource_request(&mut guest, rejoin));
10402                    let mut pending = futures::poll!(call.as_mut()).is_pending();
10403                    if late == "filed" {
10404                        commit(&state);
10405                        for _ in 0..8 {
10406                            tokio::task::yield_now().await;
10407                            pending &= futures::poll!(call.as_mut()).is_pending();
10408                        }
10409                    }
10410                    pending
10411                };
10412                assert!(pending, "{late}: the callback resumed");
10413            }
10414            assert!(
10415                !guest.retired.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
10416                "{late}: retire_current_thread tail-injects exit"
10417            );
10418            assert_eq!(guest.requests.lock().unwrap().len(), 1, "{late}");
10419            // The consuming cleanup of the same victim is admitted and answered.
10420            let (_, ack) = state
10421                .receive_rpc(
10422                    Tid::from_raw(victim.as_raw()),
10423                    (
10424                        guest.thread.thread_logical_time.clone(),
10425                        guest.thread.mm_id,
10426                        GlobalRequest::RobustListWakes(Vec::new()),
10427                    ),
10428                )
10429                .await;
10430            assert_eq!(ack, GlobalResponse::RobustListWakes(Vec::new()), "{late}");
10431            // Requests answered before ordinary admission get no answer either:
10432            // a SIGALRM ledger change is refused, and a loss notice is
10433            // recorded but not answered.
10434            for request in [
10435                GlobalRequest::Sigalrm(super::SigalrmControl::ArmProducer),
10436                GlobalRequest::RecordDeterminismLoss("victim notice".to_string()),
10437            ] {
10438                let (_, response) = state
10439                    .receive_rpc(
10440                        Tid::from_raw(victim.as_raw()),
10441                        (
10442                            guest.thread.thread_logical_time.clone(),
10443                            guest.thread.mm_id,
10444                            request,
10445                        ),
10446                    )
10447                    .await;
10448                assert_eq!(response, GlobalResponse::Retired, "{late}");
10449            }
10450        }
10451    }
10452
10453    /// A victim's request admitted before the commit whose response is
10454    /// granted, and observed by the handler, only after the commit reaches the
10455    /// handler's single response exit, which must not answer it
10456    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3994, R1). Without that exit
10457    /// guard the granted response would resume the callback.
10458    #[tokio::test]
10459    async fn a_victims_request_granted_across_the_commit_stays_unanswered() {
10460        use reverie::Tool;
10461
10462        let config = Config {
10463            sequentialize_threads: true,
10464            ..Config::default()
10465        };
10466        let [root, sender, victim] = [1, 2, 3].map(DetPid::from_raw);
10467        let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
10468        {
10469            let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10470            sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, root, true);
10471            sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, sender, true);
10472            sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, victim, true);
10473        }
10474        for tid in [root, sender, victim] {
10475            install_test_registration(&state, tid, Ivar::new());
10476            state
10477                .sched
10478                .lock()
10479                .unwrap()
10480                .record_thread_mm(tid, MmId::initial(tid));
10481        }
10482        let tool: Detcore = Detcore::new(Tid::from_raw(victim.as_raw()), &config);
10483        let mut thread = tool.init_thread_state(Tid::from_raw(victim.as_raw()), None);
10484        thread.detpid = Some(victim);
10485        let mut guest = RetirementGuest {
10486            global: &state,
10487            config: &config,
10488            thread,
10489            requests: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
10490            retired: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
10491        };
10492        let mut rejoin = Resources::new(victim);
10493        rejoin.insert(
10494            ResourceID::BlockedExternalContinue(ExternalOpId::new(victim, 7)),
10495            Permission::RW,
10496        );
10497        let response = state.sched.lock().unwrap().next_turns[&victim].resp.clone();
10498        {
10499            let mut call = std::pin::pin!(super::resource_request(&mut guest, rejoin));
10500            // Admitted and filed: the handler waits for the grant.
10501            assert!(futures::poll!(call.as_mut()).is_pending());
10502            // The scheduler grants it, and only then does the commit retire the
10503            // victim, before the handler has looked at the grant.
10504            response.put(SchedResponse::Go(None));
10505            {
10506                let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10507                let token = sched.reserve_sigkill(sender, victim, 0).unwrap().token;
10508                assert_eq!(sched.commit_sigkill(token, true).len(), 1);
10509            }
10510            for _ in 0..8 {
10511                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
10512                assert!(
10513                    futures::poll!(call.as_mut()).is_pending(),
10514                    "the granted response resumed a SIGKILLed thread's callback"
10515                );
10516            }
10517        }
10518        assert!(!guest.retired.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst));
10519    }

10521    /// Runs the calling test's body in a child copy of this test binary, and
10522    /// requires the child to exit with the policy-refusal status and print
10523    /// `expected`. Returns whether this is the child, which runs the body.
10524    /// Used where the body ends the process by refusing.
10525    fn in_child_expecting_refusal(name: &str, expected: &str) -> bool {
10526        const CHILD: &str = "HERMIT_TEST_REFUSAL_CHILD";
10527        let test = format!("{}::{name}", module_path!().split_once("::").unwrap().1);
10528        if std::env::var(CHILD).as_deref() == Ok(test.as_str()) {
10529            return true;
10530        }
10531        let output = std::process::Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
10532            .args(["--exact", &test, "--nocapture"])
10533            .env(CHILD, &test)
10534            .output()
10535            .unwrap();
10536        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
10537        assert_eq!(
10538            output.status.code(),
10539            Some(detcore_model::HERMIT_POLICY_REFUSAL_EXIT),
10540            "{test}: the child was not refused\n{stderr}"
10541        );
10542        assert!(
10543            stderr.contains(expected),
10544            "{test}: missing {expected:?}\n{stderr}"
10545        );
10546        false
10547    }
10548
10549    /// Sends the DBT SIGKILL notice for process 3, from process 1, with a
10550    /// 20 ms fence valve. Process 3's thread is registered on the host as
10551    /// `victim`'s, when given, and otherwise only modelled.
10552    async fn send_dbt_sigkill_notice(victim: Option<i32>) {
10553        let config = Config {
10554            sequentialize_threads: true,
10555            ..Config::default()
10556        }
10557        .with_backend(|backend| *backend = reverie::BackendCapabilities::DBT);
10558        let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
10559        let [root, target] = [1, 3].map(DetPid::from_raw);
10560        {
10561            let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10562            sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, root, true);
10563            sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, target, true);
10564        }
10565        for tid in [root, target] {
10566            install_test_registration(&state, tid, Ivar::new());
10567            state
10568                .sched
10569                .lock()
10570                .unwrap()
10571                .record_thread_mm(tid, MmId::initial(tid));
10572        }
10573        {
10574            let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10575            sched.sigkill_fence_valve = std::time::Duration::from_millis(20);
10576            if let Some(pid) = victim {
10577                sched
10578                    .register_physical_thread(target, MmId::initial(target), pid, pid)
10579                    .unwrap();
10580            }
10581        }
10582        let rpc = state.receive_rpc(
10583            Tid::from_raw(root.as_raw()),
10584            (
10585                crate::ThreadState::<()>::new(root, &config, ())
10586                    .thread_logical_time
10587                    .clone(),
10588                MmId::initial(root),
10589                GlobalRequest::NotifySignalPending(
10590                    target,
10591                    SigWrapper(libc::SIGKILL),
10592                    Some(target),
10593                    super::SignalScope::Process,
10594                ),
10595            ),
10596        );
10597        let _ = tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10), rpc).await;
10598    }
10599
10600    /// On DBT, a SIGKILL notice whose victim is not gone within the fence
10601    /// valve ends the run with the named refusal before the sender is
10602    /// answered (shortened valve; Claude re-check of
10603    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4423, N3).
10604    #[tokio::test]
10605    async fn a_dbt_sigkill_notice_past_its_valve_refuses_before_answering() {
10606        if !in_child_expecting_refusal(
10607            "a_dbt_sigkill_notice_past_its_valve_refuses_before_answering",
10608            "cannot be held until it is gone: it was not gone within",
10609        ) {
10610            return;
10611        }
10612        // The victim outlives the valve by far, and dies with this child
10613        // (PR_SET_PDEATHSIG) rather than outliving it (Claude re-check of
10614        // 4423 at 858d81ec, N5). Its stdio is not this child's, which the
10615        // parent reads to the end.
10616        let mut victim = std::process::Command::new("sleep");
10617        victim
10618            .arg("60")
10619            .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
10620            .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
10621            .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null());
10622        // SAFETY: prctl is async-signal-safe and touches no shared state.
10623        unsafe {
10624            use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;
10625            victim.pre_exec(|| {
10626                if libc::prctl(libc::PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, libc::SIGKILL) == 0 {
10627                    Ok(())
10628                } else {
10629                    Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error())
10630                }
10631            });
10632        }
10633        let mut victim = victim.spawn().unwrap();
10634        send_dbt_sigkill_notice(Some(victim.id() as i32)).await;
10635        let _ = victim.kill();
10636        let _ = victim.wait();
10637        panic!("the SIGKILL notice answered its sender although the victim was not gone");
10638    }
10639
10640    /// On DBT, a SIGKILL notice for a victim with a live thread but no thread
10641    /// registered on the host ends the run with the named refusal before the
10642    /// sender is answered, never left unfenced (Claude review of
10643    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4423, F2: the end-to-end form
10644    /// of this case became a passing run with
10645    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4411's fix).
10646    #[tokio::test]
10647    async fn a_dbt_sigkill_notice_with_no_host_registration_refuses_before_answering() {
10648        if !in_child_expecting_refusal(
10649            "a_dbt_sigkill_notice_with_no_host_registration_refuses_before_answering",
10650            "nor any other thread of it has a registered host process",
10651        ) {
10652            return;
10653        }
10654        send_dbt_sigkill_notice(None).await;
10655        panic!("the SIGKILL notice answered its sender without a fence");
10656    }

10658    /// A returning sender's wait for its victims is bounded by the valve: a
10659    /// commit whose victim never dies returns once the valve expires and
10660    /// refuses the run by name, instead of hanging the sender (shortened
10661    /// valve; the 30 s production bound is the same field).
10662    #[tokio::test]
10663    async fn a_sigkill_commit_wait_past_its_valve_refuses_the_run() {
10664        let config = Config {
10665            sequentialize_threads: true,
10666            ..Config::default()
10667        };
10668        let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
10669        let [root, sender, target] = [1, 2, 3].map(DetPid::from_raw);
10670        {
10671            let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10672            sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, root, true);
10673            sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, sender, true);
10674            sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, target, true);
10675        }
10676        for tid in [root, sender, target] {
10677            install_test_registration(&state, tid, Ivar::new());
10678            state
10679                .sched
10680                .lock()
10681                .unwrap()
10682                .record_thread_mm(tid, MmId::initial(tid));
10683        }
10684        let token = {
10685            let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10686            sched.sigkill_fence_valve = std::time::Duration::from_millis(20);
10687            sched.reserve_sigkill(sender, target, 0).unwrap().token
10688        };
10689        let rpc = state.receive_rpc(
10690            Tid::from_raw(sender.as_raw()),
10691            (
10692                crate::ThreadState::<()>::new(sender, &config, ())
10693                    .thread_logical_time
10694                    .clone(),
10695                MmId::initial(sender),
10696                GlobalRequest::CommitSigkill(token, true),
10697            ),
10698        );
10699        let (_, response) = tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10), rpc)
10700            .await
10701            .expect("the commit's wait outlived its valve");
10702        assert_eq!(response, GlobalResponse::CommitSigkill(()));
10703        let sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10704        let refusal = sched
10705            .sigkill_fence_refusal_for_test()
10706            .expect("no refusal recorded");
10707        assert!(refusal.waited >= std::time::Duration::from_millis(20));
10708        assert_eq!(refusal.unaccounted, [target]);
10709    }

10711    /// Two victims of one SIGKILL send their owner-death batches through this
10712    /// real RPC handler, as authenticated registered victims, in either order,
10713    /// with a step2 between the receipts (3994 design revision 4, R2). Each
10714    /// batch is acknowledged with no counts and runs only when the cohort is
10715    /// complete, so the waiters woken, the run-queue order and the fuzz arm's
10716    /// next draw do not depend on the order, under FIFO and under the fuzz
10717    /// arm. This covers the retention protocol, not a SIGKILL producer: a
10718    /// SIGKILL victim stages no batch today
10719    /// (<https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/2082>).
10720    #[tokio::test]
10721    async fn victims_owner_death_wakes_through_the_handler_do_not_depend_on_receipt_order() {
10722        async fn run(fuzz: bool, reverse: bool) -> (Vec<Vec<DetTid>>, Vec<DetTid>, u64) {
10723            let config = Config {
10724                sequentialize_threads: true,
10725                fuzz_futexes: fuzz,
10726                ..Config::default()
10727            };
10728            let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
10729            let [root, sender, target, worker] = [1, 2, 3, 4].map(DetPid::from_raw);
10730            let mm = MmId::initial(target);
10731            let futexes = [0x404100, 0x404200].map(|addr| FutexID::private(mm, addr));
10732            {
10733                let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10734                sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, root, true);
10735                sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, sender, true);
10736                sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, target, true);
10737                sched.thread_tree.add_child(target, worker, false);
10738            }
10739            for tid in [root, sender, target, worker] {
10740                install_test_registration(&state, tid, Ivar::new());
10741                state
10742                    .sched
10743                    .lock()
10744                    .unwrap()
10745                    .record_thread_mm(tid, MmId::initial(tid));
10746            }
10747            for (futex, waiters) in futexes.iter().zip([[11, 12, 13], [14, 15, 16]]) {
10748                for raw in waiters {
10749                    let tid = DetTid::from_raw(raw);
10750                    let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10751                    sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, tid, true);
10752                    sched.next_turns.insert(
10753                        tid,
10754                        ThreadNextTurn {
10755                            dettid: tid,
10756                            child_tid_addr: 0,
10757                            req: Ivar::new(),
10758                            resp: Ivar::new(),
10759                            protocol: Default::default(),
10760                        },
10761                    );
10762                    sched.priorities.insert(tid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
10763                    sched.sleep_futex_waiter(&tid, *futex, None, u32::MAX, None);
10764                }
10765            }
10766            {
10767                let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10768                let token = sched.reserve_sigkill(sender, target, 0).unwrap().token;
10769                assert_eq!(sched.commit_sigkill(token, true).len(), 2);
10770            }
10771            let mut receipts = [(target, futexes[0]), (worker, futexes[1])];
10772            if reverse {
10773                receipts.reverse();
10774            }
10775            for (victim, futex) in receipts {
10776                let (_, ack) = state
10777                    .receive_rpc(
10778                        Tid::from_raw(victim.as_raw()),
10779                        (
10780                            crate::ThreadState::<()>::new(victim, &config, ())
10781                                .thread_logical_time
10782                                .clone(),
10783                            MmId::initial(victim),
10784                            GlobalRequest::RobustListWakes(vec![(victim, futex)]),
10785                        ),
10786                    )
10787                    .await;
10788                assert_eq!(
10789                    ack,
10790                    GlobalResponse::RobustListWakes(Vec::new()),
10791                    "a victim's batch is retained, not run at receipt"
10792                );
10793                state.sched.lock().unwrap().step2_drain_prefix_for_test();
10794                // The victim's real consuming deregistration, and a duplicate:
10795                // the first is accounted once, the second changes nothing.
10796                let deregistration = ThreadDeregistration {
10797                    dettid: victim,
10798                    detpid: target,
10799                    mm: MmId::initial(victim),
10800                    thread_start_entered: true,
10801                    timeslice_stats: TimesliceStats {
10802                        count: 1,
10803                        sum_ns: 10,
10804                        min_ns: 10,
10805                        max_ns: 10,
10806                    },
10807                    syscall_count: 3,
10808                    chaos_epochs: Vec::new(),
10809                };
10810                for _ in 0..2 {
10811                    let (_, done) = state
10812                        .receive_rpc(
10813                            Tid::from_raw(victim.as_raw()),
10814                            (
10815                                crate::ThreadState::<()>::new(victim, &config, ())
10816                                    .thread_logical_time
10817                                    .clone(),
10818                                MmId::initial(victim),
10819                                GlobalRequest::DeregisterThread(deregistration.clone()),
10820                            ),
10821                        )
10822                        .await;
10823                    assert_eq!(done, GlobalResponse::DeregisterThread(()));
10824                }
10825                state.sched.lock().unwrap().step2_drain_prefix_for_test();
10826            }
10827            assert!(
10828                state.sched.lock().unwrap().sigkill_fence_holds(),
10829                "the victim's exit is not yet published to its parent"
10830            );
10831            <GlobalState as GlobalTool>::on_backend_process_exited(&state, target.as_raw());
10832            state.sched.lock().unwrap().step2_drain_prefix_for_test();
10833            {
10834                let sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10835                assert!(
10836                    !sched.sigkill_fence_holds(),
10837                    "every victim is accounted and published"
10838                );
10839                for victim in [target, worker] {
10840                    assert_eq!(
10841                        sched
10842                            .timeslice_stats_for_test(victim)
10843                            .map(|stats| stats.count),
10844                        Some(1),
10845                        "victim {victim} accounted exactly once"
10846                    );
10847                }
10848            }
10849            let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10850            let still_waiting = futexes
10851                .iter()
10852                .map(|futex| sched.futex_waiters_for_test(*futex))
10853                .collect();
10854            let queue = sched.run_queue_for_test();
10855            (still_waiting, queue, sched.next_fuzz_draw_for_test())
10856        }
10857        for fuzz in [false, true] {
10858            let forward = run(fuzz, false).await;
10859            assert_eq!(forward.0.iter().map(Vec::len).collect::<Vec<_>>(), [2, 2]);
10860            assert_eq!(forward, run(fuzz, true).await, "fuzz={fuzz}");
10861        }
10862    }

10864    /// A victim with a filed request, whose real consuming deregistration
10865    /// reaches the handler before the sender's commit (an early receipt, held)
10866    /// or after it. Both readiness orders give the same retirement: the
10867    /// callback stays pending with nothing injected (`RetirementGuest` panics
10868    /// on an injection) and is not retired, the cleanup is accounted once, the
10869    /// fence is released, and the victim's process is waitable
10870    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3994, R1).
10871    #[tokio::test]
10872    async fn a_victims_receipt_before_or_after_the_commit_retires_it_the_same_way() {
10873        use reverie::Tool;
10874
10875        let config = Config {
10876            sequentialize_threads: true,
10877            ..Config::default()
10878        };
10879        let [root, sender, victim] = [1, 2, 3].map(DetPid::from_raw);
10880        for early in [true, false] {
10881            let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
10882            {
10883                let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10884                sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, root, true);
10885                sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, sender, true);
10886                sched.thread_tree.add_child(root, victim, true);
10887            }
10888            for tid in [root, sender, victim] {
10889                install_test_registration(&state, tid, Ivar::new());
10890                state
10891                    .sched
10892                    .lock()
10893                    .unwrap()
10894                    .record_thread_mm(tid, MmId::initial(tid));
10895            }
10896            let tool: Detcore = Detcore::new(Tid::from_raw(victim.as_raw()), &config);
10897            let mut thread = tool.init_thread_state(Tid::from_raw(victim.as_raw()), None);
10898            thread.detpid = Some(victim);
10899            let clock = thread.thread_logical_time.clone();
10900            let mut guest = RetirementGuest {
10901                global: &state,
10902                config: &config,
10903                thread,
10904                requests: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
10905                retired: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
10906            };
10907            let token = state
10908                .sched
10909                .lock()
10910                .unwrap()
10911                .reserve_sigkill(sender, victim, 0)
10912                .unwrap()
10913                .token;
10914            let deregister = || {
10915                state.receive_rpc(
10916                    Tid::from_raw(victim.as_raw()),
10917                    (
10918                        clock.clone(),
10919                        MmId::initial(victim),
10920                        GlobalRequest::DeregisterThread(ThreadDeregistration {
10921                            dettid: victim,
10922                            detpid: victim,
10923                            mm: MmId::initial(victim),
10924                            thread_start_entered: true,
10925                            timeslice_stats: TimesliceStats {
10926                                count: 1,
10927                                sum_ns: 10,
10928                                min_ns: 10,
10929                                max_ns: 10,
10930                            },
10931                            syscall_count: 3,
10932                            chaos_epochs: Vec::new(),
10933                        }),
10934                    ),
10935                )
10936            };
10937            {
10938                let mut rejoin = Resources::new(victim);
10939                rejoin.insert(
10940                    ResourceID::BlockedExternalContinue(ExternalOpId::new(victim, 7)),
10941                    Permission::RW,
10942                );
10943                let mut call = std::pin::pin!(super::resource_request(&mut guest, rejoin));
10944                assert!(futures::poll!(call.as_mut()).is_pending());
10945                if early {
10946                    assert_eq!(deregister().await.1, GlobalResponse::DeregisterThread(()));
10947                }
10948                state.sched.lock().unwrap().commit_sigkill(token, true);
10949                if !early {
10950                    assert_eq!(deregister().await.1, GlobalResponse::DeregisterThread(()));
10951                }
10952                for _ in 0..4 {
10953                    tokio::task::yield_now().await;
10954                    assert!(futures::poll!(call.as_mut()).is_pending(), "early={early}");
10955                }
10956            }
10957            assert!(!guest.retired.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst));
10958            assert!(
10959                state.sched.lock().unwrap().sigkill_fence_holds(),
10960                "early={early}: the exit is not yet published"
10961            );
10962            <GlobalState as GlobalTool>::on_backend_process_exited(&state, victim.as_raw());
10963            let sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
10964            assert!(!sched.sigkill_fence_holds(), "early={early}");
10965            assert!(sched.process_is_unreaped_zombie(victim), "early={early}");
10966            assert_eq!(
10967                sched
10968                    .timeslice_stats_for_test(victim)
10969                    .map(|stats| stats.count),
10970                Some(1),
10971                "early={early}"
10972            );
10973        }
10974    }

10976    #[tokio::test]
10977    async fn thread_exited_uses_natural_retirement_for_killed_stale_and_failed_rpcs() {
10978        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
10979
10980        use reverie::Tool;
10981
10982        for cause in ["killed", "stale image", "backend failure", "live"] {
10983            let (config, state, tid, pid) = cancellation_test_state();
10984            install_test_registration(&state, tid, Ivar::new());
10985            let tool: Detcore = Detcore::new(Tid::from_raw(tid.as_raw()), &config);
10986            let mut thread = tool.init_thread_state(Tid::from_raw(tid.as_raw()), None);
10987            thread.detpid = Some(pid);
10988            thread.thread_logical_time.add_syscall_with_cost(37);
10989            match cause {
10990                "killed" => {
10991                    state
10992                        .sched
10993                        .lock()
10994                        .unwrap()
10995                        .logically_kill_thread(&tid, &pid, thread.mm_id)
10996                }
10997                "stale image" => {
10998                    state
10999                        .sched
11000                        .lock()
11001                        .unwrap()
11002                        .install_test_exec_incarnation(tid, thread.mm_id);
11003                    thread.mm_id = thread.mm_id.for_exec(pid);
11004                }
11005                "backend failure" => state.report_backend_failure(reverie::BackendFailure {
11006                    pid: Tid::from_raw(pid.as_raw()),
11007                    tid: Tid::from_raw(tid.as_raw()),
11008                    phase: "natural retirement control",
11009                }),
11010                "live" => {}
11011                _ => unreachable!(),
11012            }
11013            let mut guest = RetirementGuest {
11014                global: &state,
11015                config: &config,
11016                thread,
11017                requests: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
11018                retired: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
11019            };
11020            let before = guest.thread.thread_logical_time.as_nanos();
11021            {
11022                let mut call = std::pin::pin!(super::send_and_update_time(
11023                    &mut guest,
11024                    GlobalRequest::GlobalTimeLowerBound
11025                ));
11026                if cause == "live" {
11027                    assert!(matches!(
11028                        futures::poll!(call.as_mut()),
11029                        std::task::Poll::Ready((_, GlobalResponse::GlobalTimeLowerBound(_)))
11030                    ));
11031                } else {
11032                    assert!(futures::poll!(call.as_mut()).is_pending(), "{cause}");
11033                }
11034            }
11035            // A terminal backend failure closes ordinary RPC admission before
11036            // any ThreadExited response. The backend failure subscription owns
11037            // cancellation of that pending callback; it must not retire as success.
11038            assert_eq!(
11039                guest.retired.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
11040                matches!(cause, "killed" | "stale image"),
11041                "{cause}"
11042            );
11043            assert_eq!(guest.requests.lock().unwrap().len(), 1);
11044            assert_eq!(guest.thread.thread_logical_time.as_nanos(), before);
11045            if cause == "backend failure" {
11046                assert!(state.sched.lock().unwrap().backend_failed());
11047                assert!(
11048                    futures::poll!(std::pin::pin!(state.wait_for_backend_failure())).is_ready()
11049                );
11050            }
11051        }
11052    }

11054    async fn check_external_child_tid_registration(
11055        flags: CloneFlags,
11056        supplied_address: usize,
11057        expected_address: usize,
11058    ) {
11059        use reverie::Tool;
11060
11061        let config = Config {
11062            sequentialize_threads: true,
11063            // This control observes registration before the child starts; use
11064            // the supported parent-first order for the one turn it drives.
11065            runs_post_fork: crate::RunsPostFork::Parent,
11066            ..Config::default()
11067        }
11068        .with_backend(|backend| {
11069            backend.needs_killed_thread_rpc_cancellation = true;
11070        });
11071        let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
11072        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(17);
11073        let parent_pid = DetPid::from_raw(17);
11074        state
11075            .sched
11076            .lock()
11077            .unwrap()
11078            .thread_tree
11079            .add_child(parent, parent, true);
11080        install_test_registration(&state, parent, Ivar::new());
11081        let tool = Detcore::new(reverie::Pid::from_raw(parent.as_raw()), &config);
11082        let mut thread = tool.init_thread_state(Tid::from_raw(parent.as_raw()), None);
11083        thread.detpid = Some(parent_pid);
11084        let mut guest = ExternalRegistrationGuest {
11085            global: &state,
11086            config: &config,
11087            thread,
11088            requests: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
11089            post_exec: false,
11090        };
11091        let child = DetTid::from_raw(18);
11092        let exit_signal = if flags.contains(CloneFlags::CLONE_THREAD) {
11093            0
11094        } else {
11095            libc::SIGCHLD
11096        };
11097        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
11098            let mut registration = std::pin::pin!(tool.register_external_child(
11099                &mut guest,
11100                Tid::from_raw(child.as_raw()),
11101                supplied_address,
11102                flags,
11103                exit_signal,
11104                None,
11105            ));
11106            assert!(futures::poll!(registration.as_mut()).is_pending());
11107            // The production RPC parks the parent on ParentContinue. Drive
11108            // that actual scheduler turn instead of pre-filling a response or
11109            // disabling sequentialization to make registration return.
11110            let committed = crate::scheduler::do_a_turn_blocking(
11111                state.sched.clone(),
11112                state.global_time.clone(),
11113                &Err(crate::scheduler::SkipTurn),
11114            )
11115            .await
11116            .expect("the parent continuation must commit");
11117            assert_eq!(committed.tid, parent);
11118            assert_eq!(
11119                committed.resources,
11120                std::collections::HashMap::from([(
11121                    crate::resources::ResourceID::ParentContinue { parent, child },
11122                    crate::resources::Permission::W,
11123                )]),
11124            );
11125            registration.await;
11126        })
11127        .await
11128        .expect("external child registration must return without running a guest");
11129
11130        assert_eq!(guest.thread.clone_flags, None);
11131        assert_eq!(guest.thread.dettid, parent);
11132        let mut scheduler = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
11133        assert_eq!(scheduler.next_turns.len(), 2);
11134        assert!(scheduler.next_turns.contains_key(&parent));
11135        assert_eq!(
11136            scheduler.next_turns[&child].child_tid_addr,
11137            expected_address
11138        );
11139        assert_eq!(
11140            *guest.requests.lock().unwrap(),
11141            vec![GlobalRequest::CreateChildThread(
11142                child,
11143                parent_pid,
11144                expected_address,
11145                Some(flags),
11146                exit_signal,
11147                None,
11148                Some(DEFAULT_PRIORITY),
11149            )],
11150            "external registration must send one correctly gated real RPC"
11151        );
11152        let child_pid = if flags.contains(CloneFlags::CLONE_THREAD) {
11153            parent_pid
11154        } else {
11155            child
11156        };
11157        let child_mm = MmId::for_clone(
11158            MmId::initial(parent_pid),
11159            child,
11160            flags.contains(CloneFlags::CLONE_VM),
11161        );
11162        scheduler.logically_kill_thread(&child, &child_pid, child_mm);
11163        assert!(!scheduler.next_turns.contains_key(&child));
11164        assert!(scheduler.next_turns.contains_key(&parent));
11165        assert_eq!(
11166            scheduler.child_tid_was_cleared(
11167                FutexID::private(child_mm, supplied_address),
11168                child.as_raw(),
11169            ),
11170            expected_address != 0,
11171            "exit must use only the registered child-TID address"
11172        );
11173        assert!(!scheduler.child_tid_was_cleared(FutexID::private(child_mm, 0), child.as_raw(),));
11174        assert!(!scheduler.child_tid_was_cleared(
11175            FutexID::private(child_mm, supplied_address),
11176            parent.as_raw(),
11177        ));
11178    }

11246    /// A successful SIGKILL reaches the scheduler's record through the RPCs a
11247    /// sender makes in its turn: a process named by `kill`, and a SIGKILL with
11248    /// no named victim; another signal records nothing
11249    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3904).
11250    #[tokio::test]
11251    async fn sigkill_notifications_record_the_doomed_process() {
11252        let (config, state, dettid, detpid) = cancellation_test_state();
11253        let notify = |request| {
11254            state.receive_rpc(
11255                reverie::Tid::from_raw(dettid.as_raw()),
11256                (DetTime::new(&config), MmId::initial(detpid), request),
11257            )
11258        };
11259        let victim = DetPid::from_raw(41);
11260        assert_eq!(
11261            notify(GlobalRequest::NotifySignalPending(
11262                DetTid::from_raw(41),
11263                SigWrapper(libc::SIGKILL),
11264                Some(victim),
11265                super::SignalScope::Process,
11266            ))
11267            .await
11268            .1,
11269            GlobalResponse::NotifySignalPending(())
11270        );
11271        assert_eq!(
11272            state.sched.lock().unwrap().sigkill_recorded(victim),
11273            (true, false)
11274        );
11275        let other = DetPid::from_raw(43);
11276        notify(GlobalRequest::NotifySignalPending(
11277            DetTid::from_raw(43),
11278            SigWrapper(libc::SIGTERM),
11279            Some(other),
11280            super::SignalScope::Process,
11281        ))
11282        .await;
11283        assert_eq!(
11284            state.sched.lock().unwrap().sigkill_recorded(other),
11285            (false, false)
11286        );
11287        // A process-group kill records every process in the group.
11288        assert_eq!(
11289            notify(GlobalRequest::NotifyUnresolvedSigkill(Some(detpid)))
11290                .await
11291                .1,
11292            GlobalResponse::NotifyUnresolvedSigkill(())
11293        );
11294        assert_eq!(
11295            state.sched.lock().unwrap().sigkill_recorded(detpid),
11296            (true, false)
11297        );
11298        assert_eq!(
11299            notify(GlobalRequest::NotifyUnresolvedSigkill(None)).await.1,
11300            GlobalResponse::NotifyUnresolvedSigkill(())
11301        );
11302        assert_eq!(
11303            state.sched.lock().unwrap().sigkill_recorded(other),
11304            (false, true)
11305        );
11306    }

11308    async fn child_start_clock_trajectory(
11309        start_before_selection: bool,
11310        child_first: bool,
11311    ) -> (Vec<LogicalTime>, Vec<DetTid>, bool) {
11312        let config = Config {
11313            sequentialize_threads: true,
11314            runs_post_fork: if child_first {
11315                RunsPostFork::Child
11316            } else {
11317                RunsPostFork::Parent
11318            },
11319            ..Config::default()
11320        };
11321        let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
11322        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(17);
11323        let parent_pid = parent;
11324        state
11325            .sched
11326            .lock()
11327            .unwrap()
11328            .thread_tree
11329            .add_child(parent, parent, true);
11330        let child = DetTid::from_raw(parent.as_raw() + 1);
11331        let parent_mm = MmId::initial(parent_pid);
11332        let child_mm = MmId::for_clone(parent_mm, child, false);
11333        install_test_registration(&state, parent, Ivar::new());
11334        let epoch = DetTime::new(&config).as_nanos();
11335        let mut parent_clock = DetTime::new(&config);
11336        parent_clock.advance_to(epoch + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_001));
11337        let child_clock = parent_clock.clone_for_child();
11338
11339        // Polling the real parent RPC publishes both admission and
11340        // ParentContinue before it waits, just as the clone handler does.
11341        let mut registration = Box::pin(state.receive_rpc(
11342            Tid::from_raw(parent.as_raw()),
11343            (
11344                parent_clock.clone(),
11345                parent_mm,
11346                GlobalRequest::CreateChildThread(
11347                    child,
11348                    parent_pid,
11349                    0,
11350                    Some(CloneFlags::empty()),
11351                    libc::SIGCHLD,
11352                    None,
11353                    Some(DEFAULT_PRIORITY),
11354                ),
11355            ),
11356        ));
11357        assert!(futures::poll!(&mut registration).is_pending());
11358        let child_request = state.sched.lock().unwrap().next_turns[&child].req.clone();
11359        let mut startup = Box::pin(state.receive_rpc(
11360            Tid::from_raw(child.as_raw()),
11361            (
11362                child_clock.clone(),
11363                child_mm,
11364                GlobalRequest::StartNewThread(child, child, None, None),
11365            ),
11366        ));
11367        if start_before_selection {
11368            // recv_start_new_thread yields once before filling its request.
11369            assert!(futures::poll!(&mut startup).is_pending());
11370            assert!(futures::poll!(&mut startup).is_pending());
11371            assert!(child_request.try_read().is_some());
11372        }
11373
11374        let skipped = Err(crate::scheduler::SkipTurn);
11375        let mut turn = Box::pin(crate::scheduler::do_a_turn_blocking(
11376            state.sched.clone(),
11377            state.global_time.clone(),
11378            &skipped,
11379        ));
11380        if !start_before_selection && child_first {
11381            assert!(futures::poll!(&mut turn).is_pending());
11382            assert_eq!(child_request.to_string(), "<ivar HasWaiter>");
11383            assert!(futures::poll!(&mut startup).is_pending());
11384            assert!(futures::poll!(&mut startup).is_pending());
11385            assert!(child_request.try_read().is_some());
11386        }
11387        let first = turn.await.expect("first post-fork turn must commit");
11388        if !start_before_selection && !child_first {
11389            assert!(child_request.try_read().is_none());
11390            assert!(futures::poll!(&mut startup).is_pending());
11391            assert!(futures::poll!(&mut startup).is_pending());
11392            assert!(child_request.try_read().is_some());
11393        }
11394        let child_resource = ResourceID::MemAddrSpace(child);
11395        let parent_resource = ResourceID::ParentContinue { parent, child };
11396        let (first_tid, first_resource, first_permission, second_resource, second_permission) =
11397            if child_first {
11398                (
11399                    child,
11400                    &child_resource,
11401                    Permission::RW,
11402                    &parent_resource,
11403                    Permission::W,
11404                )
11405            } else {
11406                (
11407                    parent,
11408                    &parent_resource,
11409                    Permission::W,
11410                    &child_resource,
11411                    Permission::RW,
11412                )
11413            };
11414        assert_eq!(first.tid, first_tid);
11415        assert_eq!(first.resources.len(), 1);
11416        assert_eq!(first.resources.get(first_resource), Some(&first_permission));
11417        if child_first {
11418            assert_eq!(
11419                startup.as_mut().await,
11420                (None, GlobalResponse::StartNewThread(None))
11421            );
11422        } else {
11423            assert_eq!(
11424                registration.as_mut().await,
11425                (None, GlobalResponse::CreateChildThread(None))
11426            );
11427        }
11428        let first_time = state.sched.lock().unwrap().committed_time;
11429        assert_eq!(first_time, epoch + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_001));
11430        assert_eq!(
11431            state.global_time.lock().unwrap().threads_time(child),
11432            child_clock.as_nanos()
11433        );
11434
11435        // The selected thread's first new nanosecond and the ordinary scheduler
11436        // increment must both remain observable on the other thread's turn.
11437        let (mut first_clock, first_mm) = if child_first {
11438            (child_clock, child_mm)
11439        } else {
11440            (parent_clock, parent_mm)
11441        };
11442        first_clock.advance_to(first_clock.as_nanos() + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1));
11443        let mut resources = Resources::new(first_tid);
11444        resources.insert(ResourceID::MemAddrSpace(first_tid), Permission::RW);
11445        let mut work = Box::pin(state.receive_rpc(
11446            Tid::from_raw(first_tid.as_raw()),
11447            (
11448                first_clock,
11449                first_mm,
11450                GlobalRequest::RequestResources(resources, first_tid),
11451            ),
11452        ));
11453        assert!(futures::poll!(&mut work).is_pending());
11454        let second = crate::scheduler::do_a_turn_blocking(
11455            state.sched.clone(),
11456            state.global_time.clone(),
11457            &Ok(first),
11458        )
11459        .await
11460        .expect("other thread's continuation must commit");
11461        assert_eq!(second.resources.len(), 1);
11462        assert_eq!(
11463            second.resources.get(second_resource),
11464            Some(&second_permission)
11465        );
11466        if child_first {
11467            assert_eq!(
11468                registration.await,
11469                (None, GlobalResponse::CreateChildThread(None))
11470            );
11471        } else {
11472            assert_eq!(startup.await, (None, GlobalResponse::StartNewThread(None)));
11473        }
11474        let mut scheduler = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
11475        let next_time = scheduler.committed_time;
11476        assert_eq!(next_time, epoch + LogicalTime::from_nanos(501_002));
11477        let queue = scheduler.run_queue.tids().copied().collect();
11478        let next_random = scheduler.child_runs_first_post_fork(RunsPostFork::Random);
11479        (vec![first_time, next_time], queue, next_random)
11480    }

11487                child_start_clock_trajectory(false, child_first).await,

11492    #[tokio::test]
11493    async fn vfork_registration_does_not_charge_inherited_work_before_startup() {
11494        let (config, state, parent, parent_pid) = cancellation_test_state();
11495        let child = DetTid::from_raw(parent.as_raw() + 1);
11496        let mm = MmId::initial(parent_pid);
11497        install_test_registration(&state, parent, Ivar::new());
11498        let mut parent_clock = DetTime::new(&config);
11499        let epoch = parent_clock.as_nanos();
11500        parent_clock.advance_to(epoch + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_001));
11501        let child_clock = parent_clock.clone_for_child();
11502        let mut resources = Resources::new(parent);
11503        resources.insert(
11504            ResourceID::BlockingVfork(ExternalOpId::new(parent, 1)),
11505            Permission::RW,
11506        );
11507        let mut blocking = Box::pin(state.receive_rpc(
11508            Tid::from_raw(parent.as_raw()),
11509            (
11510                parent_clock,
11511                mm,
11512                GlobalRequest::RequestResources(resources, parent_pid),
11513            ),
11514        ));
11515        assert!(futures::poll!(&mut blocking).is_pending());
11516        let background = crate::scheduler::do_a_turn_blocking(
11517            state.sched.clone(),
11518            state.global_time.clone(),
11519            &Err(crate::scheduler::SkipTurn),
11520        )
11521        .await;
11522        assert!(background.is_err());
11523        assert_eq!(
11524            blocking.await,
11525            (None, GlobalResponse::RequestResources(ResumeStatus::Normal))
11526        );
11527        let before_child = state.global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos();
11528        assert_eq!(before_child, epoch + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_001));
11529
11530        // Unlike ordinary clone, this first RPC is sent by the child itself.
11531        let created = state
11532            .receive_rpc(
11533                Tid::from_raw(child.as_raw()),
11534                (
11535                    child_clock.clone(),
11536                    mm,
11537                    GlobalRequest::CreateVforkChildThread(
11538                        parent,
11539                        parent_pid,
11540                        child,
11541                        0,
11542                        CloneFlags::CLONE_VFORK | CloneFlags::CLONE_VM,
11543                        libc::SIGCHLD,
11544                        Some(DEFAULT_PRIORITY - 1),
11545                    ),
11546                ),
11547            )
11548            .await;
11549        assert_eq!(created, (None, GlobalResponse::CreateChildThread(None)));
11550        assert_eq!(state.global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos(), before_child);
11551        assert_eq!(
11552            state.global_time.lock().unwrap().threads_time(child),
11553            child_clock.as_nanos()
11554        );
11555
11556        let mut startup = Box::pin(state.receive_rpc(
11557            Tid::from_raw(child.as_raw()),
11558            (
11559                child_clock,
11560                mm,
11561                GlobalRequest::StartNewThread(child, child, None, None),
11562            ),
11563        ));
11564        assert!(futures::poll!(&mut startup).is_pending());
11565        assert!(futures::poll!(&mut startup).is_pending());
11566        let first = crate::scheduler::do_a_turn_blocking(
11567            state.sched.clone(),
11568            state.global_time.clone(),
11569            &background,
11570        )
11571        .await
11572        .expect("vfork child must receive its first turn");
11573        assert_eq!(first.tid, child);
11574        assert_eq!(startup.await, (None, GlobalResponse::StartNewThread(None)));
11575        assert_eq!(state.global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos(), before_child);
11576    }

11621    #[tokio::test]
11622    async fn exec_reconnect_retains_inherited_work_accounting_across_local_reload() {
11623        let (config, state, leader, detpid) = cancellation_test_state();
11624        let ancestor = DetTid::from_raw(leader.as_raw() - 1);
11625        let worker = DetTid::from_raw(leader.as_raw() + 1);
11626        let old_mm = MmId::initial(detpid);
11627        install_test_registration(&state, leader, Ivar::new());
11628        state
11629            .sched
11630            .lock()
11631            .unwrap()
11632            .thread_tree
11633            .add_child(leader, worker, false);
11634        install_test_registration(&state, worker, Ivar::new());
11635
11636        let mut ancestor_clock = DetTime::new(&config);
11637        let epoch = ancestor_clock.as_nanos();
11638        ancestor_clock.advance_to(epoch + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_000));
11639        let mut leader_clock = ancestor_clock.clone_for_child();
11640        leader_clock.advance_to(epoch + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_100));
11641        let mut worker_clock = leader_clock.clone_for_child();
11642        worker_clock.advance_to(epoch + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_350));
11643        for (tid, clock) in [
11644            (ancestor, ancestor_clock),
11645            (leader, leader_clock),
11646            (worker, worker_clock.clone()),
11647        ] {
11648            let _ = state
11649                .receive_rpc(
11650                    Tid::from_raw(tid.as_raw()),
11651                    (clock, old_mm, GlobalRequest::GlobalTimeLowerBound),
11652                )
11653                .await;
11654        }
11655        let total = state.global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos();
11656        assert_eq!(total, epoch + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_350));
11657        // A failed exec cancels its pending transfer without changing either
11658        // inherited component. The next successful attempt must use the same
11659        // clocks, not charge either component's inherited work again.
11660        let _ = state
11661            .receive_rpc(
11662                Tid::from_raw(worker.as_raw()),
11663                (
11664                    worker_clock.clone(),
11665                    old_mm,
11666                    GlobalRequest::PrepareExec(detpid, old_mm, Default::default()),
11667                ),
11668            )
11669            .await;
11670        let cancelled = state
11671            .receive_rpc(
11672                Tid::from_raw(worker.as_raw()),
11673                (
11674                    worker_clock.clone(),
11675                    old_mm,
11676                    GlobalRequest::CancelExec(detpid),
11677                ),
11678            )
11679            .await;
11680        assert_eq!(cancelled, (None, GlobalResponse::CancelExec(())));
11681        assert!(state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
11682        assert_eq!(state.global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos(), total);
11683        assert_eq!(
11684            state.global_time.lock().unwrap().threads_time(worker),
11685            worker_clock.as_nanos()
11686        );
11687
11688        let prepared = state
11689            .receive_rpc(
11690                Tid::from_raw(worker.as_raw()),
11691                (
11692                    worker_clock.clone(),
11693                    old_mm,
11694                    GlobalRequest::PrepareExec(detpid, old_mm, Default::default()),
11695                ),
11696            )
11697            .await;
11698        assert_eq!(prepared, (None, GlobalResponse::PrepareExec(())));
11699
11700        let mut fresh = DetTime::new(&config);
11701        let recreated = state
11702            .receive_rpc(
11703                Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
11704                (
11705                    fresh.clone(),
11706                    MmId::initial(leader),
11707                    GlobalRequest::CreateChildThread(
11708                        leader,
11709                        detpid,
11710                        0,
11711                        None,
11712                        libc::SIGCHLD,
11713                        None,
11714                        Some(DEFAULT_PRIORITY),
11715                    ),
11716                ),
11717            )
11718            .await;
11719        assert_eq!(
11720            recreated,
11721            (
11722                Some(worker_clock.as_nanos()),
11723                GlobalResponse::CreateChildThread(Some(old_mm.for_exec(detpid)))
11724            )
11725        );
11726        // A delayed request from the destroyed image must be rejected before
11727        // its absolute clock or its inherited metadata reaches accounting.
11728        let stale = state
11729            .receive_rpc(
11730                Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
11731                (
11732                    worker_clock.clone(),
11733                    old_mm,
11734                    GlobalRequest::RequestResources(Resources::new(leader), detpid),
11735                ),
11736            )
11737            .await;
11738        assert_eq!(stale, (None, GlobalResponse::ThreadExited));
11739        assert_eq!(state.global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos(), total);
11740
11741        fresh.advance_to(recreated.0.unwrap());
11742        assert_eq!(fresh.inherited_nanos(), LogicalTime::ZERO);
11743        let mut startup = Box::pin(state.receive_rpc(
11744            Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
11745            (
11746                fresh.clone(),
11747                old_mm.for_exec(detpid),
11748                GlobalRequest::StartNewThread(leader, detpid, None, None),
11749            ),
11750        ));
11751        assert!(futures::poll!(&mut startup).is_pending());
11752        assert!(futures::poll!(&mut startup).is_pending());
11753        let first = crate::scheduler::do_a_turn_blocking(
11754            state.sched.clone(),
11755            state.global_time.clone(),
11756            &Err(crate::scheduler::SkipTurn),
11757        )
11758        .await
11759        .expect("replacement leader must run");
11760        assert_eq!(first.tid, leader);
11761        assert_eq!(startup.await, (None, GlobalResponse::StartNewThread(None)));
11762        assert_eq!(state.global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos(), total);
11763
11764        fresh.advance_to(fresh.as_nanos() + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1));
11765        let observed = state
11766            .receive_rpc(
11767                Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
11768                (
11769                    fresh.clone(),
11770                    old_mm.for_exec(detpid),
11771                    GlobalRequest::GlobalTimeLowerBound,
11772                ),
11773            )
11774            .await;
11775        assert_eq!(
11776            observed,
11777            (
11778                None,
11779                GlobalResponse::GlobalTimeLowerBound(total + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1))
11780            )
11781        );
11782        let global = state.global_time.lock().unwrap();
11783        assert_eq!(global.threads_time(leader), fresh.as_nanos());
11784        assert!(!global.contains_thread(worker));
11785    }

11895                        0,
11896                        None,
11897                        libc::SIGCHLD,
11898                        physical_ids,
11899                        Some(DEFAULT_PRIORITY),
11900                    ),
11901                ),
11902            )
11903            .await;
11904        assert_eq!(
11905            create_response,
11906            (
11907                Some(thread_before),
11908                GlobalResponse::CreateChildThread(Some(old_mm.for_exec(detpid)))
11909            )
11910        );
11911        assert_eq!(
11912            state.sched.lock().unwrap().physical_thread_identity(dettid),
11913            Some((old_mm.for_exec(detpid), physical_pid, physical_tid)),
11914            "post-exec host identity must be installed by CreateChildThread before admission"
11915        );
11916
11917        let start_response = state
11918            .receive_rpc(
11919                reverie::Tid::from_raw(dettid.as_raw()),
11920                (
11921                    fresh_local_time,
11922                    old_mm.for_exec(detpid),
11923                    GlobalRequest::StartNewThread(dettid, detpid, physical_ids, None),
11924                ),
11925            )
11926            .await;
11927        assert_eq!(
11928            start_response,
11929            (Some(thread_before), GlobalResponse::StartNewThread(None))
11930        );
11931
11932        let scheduler = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
11933        assert!(!scheduler.thread_is_logically_killed(dettid));
11934        assert!(scheduler.thread_is_logically_killed(sibling));
11935        assert_eq!(scheduler.next_turns.len(), 1);
11936        assert!(matches!(sibling_request.try_read(), Some(Err(_))));
11937        assert!(
11938            scheduler.child_tid_was_cleared(FutexID::private(old_mm, 0x1234), sibling.as_raw())
11939        );
11940        drop(scheduler);
11941        let global_time = state.global_time.lock().unwrap();
11942        assert_eq!(global_time.as_nanos(), global_before);
11943        assert_eq!(global_time.threads_time(dettid), thread_before);
11944    }

11946    /// A waiter in another process, parked on a robust word the exec's caller
11947    /// owned, for the exec owner-death tests below.
11948    fn park_exec_robust_waiter(state: &GlobalState, futex: FutexID) -> DetTid {
11949        park_exec_robust_waiter_as(state, futex, 40)
11950    }
11951
11952    /// [`park_exec_robust_waiter`] for the thread `raw`.
11953    fn park_exec_robust_waiter_as(state: &GlobalState, futex: FutexID, raw: i32) -> DetTid {
11954        let waiter = DetTid::from_raw(raw);
11955        state
11956            .sched
11957            .lock()
11958            .unwrap()
11959            .thread_tree
11960            .add_child(waiter, waiter, true);
11961        install_test_registration(state, waiter, Ivar::new());
11962        let mut scheduler = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
11963        scheduler.sleep_futex_waiter(&waiter, futex, None, u32::MAX, None);
11964        assert!(scheduler.run_queue.remove_tid(waiter));
11965        waiter
11966    }
