11968    /// On a backend whose new image reconnects with a fresh runtime (DBT),
11969    /// the owner-death wakes the exec's caller read before the native exec
11970    /// travel with the prepared exec, and the reconnect admits their waiters
11971    /// at the next deterministic drain
11972    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4268).
11973    #[tokio::test]
11974    async fn exec_reconnect_wakes_the_robust_waiters_its_exec_marked() {
11975        let (config, state, dettid, detpid) = cancellation_test_state();
11976        let old_mm = MmId::initial(detpid).for_exec(detpid);
11977        install_test_registration(&state, dettid, Ivar::new());
11978        let mut existing_time = DetTime::new(&config);
11979        existing_time.add_syscall();
11980        state.global_time.lock().unwrap().update_global_time(
11981            dettid,
11982            existing_time.as_nanos(),
11983            LogicalTime::ZERO,
11984        );
11985        let futex = FutexID::private(old_mm, 0x4000);
11986        let waiter = park_exec_robust_waiter(&state, futex);
11987        state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap().insert(
11988            detpid,
11989            PendingExecState {
11990                caller: dettid,
11991                process: detpid,
11992                mm: old_mm,
11993                fd_blocking: ExecFdState {
11994                    robust_wakes: vec![(dettid, futex)],
11995                    ..Default::default()
11996                },
11997            },
11998        );
11999        state
12000            .sched
12001            .lock()
12002            .unwrap()
12003            .install_test_exec_incarnation(dettid, old_mm);
12004        assert!(!state.sched.lock().unwrap().admission_pending(waiter));
12005
12006        let create_response = state
12007            .receive_rpc(
12008                reverie::Tid::from_raw(dettid.as_raw()),
12009                (
12010                    DetTime::new(&config),
12011                    MmId::initial(dettid),
12012                    GlobalRequest::CreateChildThread(
12013                        dettid,
12014                        detpid,
12015                        0,
12016                        None,
12017                        libc::SIGCHLD,
12018                        None,
12019                        Some(DEFAULT_PRIORITY),
12020                    ),
12021                ),
12022            )
12023            .await;
12024        assert_eq!(
12025            create_response.1,
12026            GlobalResponse::CreateChildThread(Some(old_mm.for_exec(detpid)))
12027        );
12028        assert!(state.sched.lock().unwrap().admission_pending(waiter));
12029        assert!(
12030            state
12031                .post_exec_fd_blocking
12032                .lock()
12033                .unwrap()
12034                .get(&dettid)
12035                .is_none_or(|carried| carried.robust_wakes.is_empty()),
12036            "the wakes are delivered once, at the reconnect"
12037        );
12038    }

12040    /// An exec that fails before its point of no return (here ENOENT, which
12041    /// takes CancelExec) marks no robust word, so its prepared wakes are
12042    /// dropped with the prepared exec and the waiter stays parked. An exec
12043    /// that ends its group without a reconnect delivers them instead
12044    /// (`a_terminal_exec_wakes_its_robust_waiters`).
12045    #[tokio::test]
12046    async fn a_failed_exec_drops_its_robust_wakes() {
12047        let (config, state, leader, detpid) = cancellation_test_state();
12048        install_test_registration(&state, leader, Ivar::new());
12049        let futex = FutexID::private(MmId::initial(detpid), 0x4000);
12050        let waiter = park_exec_robust_waiter(&state, futex);
12051        let clock = DetTime::new(&config);
12052        let prepared = state
12053            .receive_rpc(
12054                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12055                (
12056                    clock.clone(),
12057                    MmId::initial(leader),
12058                    GlobalRequest::PrepareExec(
12059                        detpid,
12060                        MmId::initial(detpid),
12061                        Box::new(ExecFdState {
12062                            robust_wakes: vec![(leader, futex)],
12063                            ..Default::default()
12064                        }),
12065                    ),
12066                ),
12067            )
12068            .await;
12069        assert_eq!(prepared.1, GlobalResponse::PrepareExec(()));
12070        let cancelled = state
12071            .receive_rpc(
12072                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12073                (
12074                    clock,
12075                    MmId::initial(leader),
12076                    GlobalRequest::CancelExec(detpid),
12077                ),
12078            )
12079            .await;
12080        assert_eq!(cancelled.1, GlobalResponse::CancelExec(()));
12081        assert!(state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
12082        assert!(!state.sched.lock().unwrap().admission_pending(waiter));
12083    }

12085    /// An exec caller whose old image deregisters before any reconnect (its
12086    /// group killed during the exec) still had Linux walk the group's robust
12087    /// lists. The deregistration delivers the prepared wakes and holds turns
12088    /// until the kernel has ended the group, instead of dropping them with
12089    /// the preparation (Codex review of
12090    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4352, P2). This builds the
12091    /// deregistration directly: no guest action is known to reach it on DBT
12092    /// (an exec whose target cannot be loaded reconnects first, then hangs
12093    /// the run: <https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4362>).
12094    #[tokio::test]
12095    async fn a_terminal_exec_wakes_its_robust_waiters() {
12096        let (config, state, leader, detpid) = cancellation_test_state();
12097        install_test_registration(&state, leader, Ivar::new());
12098        let (tid_tx, tid_rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
12099        let (exit_tx, exit_rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel::<()>();
12100        let host_thread = std::thread::spawn(move || {
12101            tid_tx
12102                .send(unsafe { libc::syscall(libc::SYS_gettid) as i32 })
12103                .unwrap();
12104            let _ = exit_rx.recv();
12105        });
12106        state
12107            .sched
12108            .lock()
12109            .unwrap()
12110            .register_physical_thread(
12111                leader,
12112                MmId::initial(detpid),
12113                std::process::id() as i32,
12114                tid_rx.recv().unwrap(),
12115            )
12116            .unwrap();
12117        let futex = FutexID::private(MmId::initial(detpid), 0x4000);
12118        let waiter = park_exec_robust_waiter(&state, futex);
12119        // A second waiter on the same word stays parked: one wake per marked
12120        // word (Claude re-check of
12121        // https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4352, N3).
12122        let second = park_exec_robust_waiter_as(&state, futex, 41);
12123        let prepared = state
12124            .receive_rpc(
12125                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12126                (
12127                    DetTime::new(&config),
12128                    MmId::initial(leader),
12129                    GlobalRequest::PrepareExec(
12130                        detpid,
12131                        MmId::initial(detpid),
12132                        Box::new(ExecFdState {
12133                            robust_wakes: vec![(leader, futex)],
12134                            ..Default::default()
12135                        }),
12136                    ),
12137                ),
12138            )
12139            .await;
12140        assert_eq!(prepared.1, GlobalResponse::PrepareExec(()));
12141        assert!(!state.sched.lock().unwrap().admission_pending(waiter));
12142
12143        state
12144            .recv_deregister_thread(
12145                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12146                ThreadDeregistration {
12147                    thread_start_entered: true,
12148                    dettid: leader,
12149                    detpid,
12150                    mm: MmId::initial(detpid),
12151                    timeslice_stats: TimesliceStats::default(),
12152                    syscall_count: 0,
12153                    chaos_epochs: Vec::new(),
12154                },
12155            )
12156            .await;
12157        assert!(state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
12158        {
12159            let scheduler = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
12160            assert!(scheduler.admission_pending(waiter));
12161            assert!(!scheduler.admission_pending(second));
12162            assert!(scheduler.holds_turns_until_gone(leader));
12163        }
12164        exit_tx.send(()).unwrap();
12165        host_thread.join().unwrap();
12166    }

12168    #[tokio::test]
12169    async fn nonleader_exec_rebinds_caller_to_leader_and_preserves_its_clock() {
12170        let (config, state, leader, detpid) = cancellation_test_state();
12171        let worker = DetTid::from_raw(leader.as_raw() + 1);
12172        let sibling = DetTid::from_raw(leader.as_raw() + 2);
12173        let old_mm = MmId::initial(detpid).for_exec(detpid);
12174        let leader_request = Ivar::new();
12175        let worker_request = Ivar::new();

12177        install_test_registration(&state, leader, leader_request.clone());
12178        {
12179            let mut scheduler = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
12180            scheduler.thread_tree.add_child(leader, worker, false);
12181            scheduler.thread_tree.add_child(leader, sibling, false);
12182        }
12183        install_test_registration(&state, worker, worker_request.clone());
12184        install_test_registration(&state, sibling, sibling_request.clone());
12185        {
12186            let mut scheduler = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
12187            scheduler
12188                .next_turns
12189                .get_mut(&sibling)
12190                .unwrap()
12191                .child_tid_addr = 0x5678;
12192            scheduler
12193                .timeslices
12194                .insert(leader, Some(LogicalTime::from_nanos(99)));
12195            scheduler.install_test_vfork_barrier(leader, sibling);
12196        }
12197
12198        let mut leader_clock = DetTime::new(&config);
12199        leader_clock.add_syscall();
12200        let mut worker_clock = DetTime::new(&config);
12201        worker_clock.add_syscall();
12202        worker_clock.add_syscall();
12203        worker_clock.add_syscall();
12204        {
12205            let mut global_time = state.global_time.lock().unwrap();
12206            global_time.update_global_time(leader, leader_clock.as_nanos(), LogicalTime::ZERO);
12207            global_time.update_global_time(worker, worker_clock.as_nanos(), LogicalTime::ZERO);
12208        }
12209        let total_before = state.global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos();
12210        let fd_blocking = ExecFdState {
12211            blocking: [42].into_iter().collect(),
12212            inherited_reads: std::collections::BTreeMap::from([(
12213                43,
12214                crate::fd::InheritedExternalRead {
12215                    origin: crate::types::OpenFileId::new(leader, 0),
12216                    dev: 1,
12217                    inode: 2,
12218                    rdev: 3,
12219                    file_type: libc::S_IFCHR,
12220                    access_mode: libc::O_RDONLY,
12221                    resource: Some(ResourceID::Device(crate::resources::Device::ContainerStdin)),
12222                },
12223            )]),
12224            initialize_inherited_stdio: false,
12225            initial_input: None,
12226            robust_wakes: Vec::new(),
12227            open_files: None,
12228            channels: Default::default(),
12229            open_file_namespace: None,
12230            exe: None,
12231        };
12232        state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap().insert(
12233            detpid,
12234            PendingExecState {
12235                caller: worker,
12236                process: detpid,
12237                mm: old_mm,
12238                fd_blocking: fd_blocking.clone(),
12239            },
12240        );
12241        let fresh_local_time = DetTime::new(&config);
12242
12243        let create_response = state
12244            .receive_rpc(
12245                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12246                (
12247                    fresh_local_time.clone(),
12248                    MmId::initial(leader),
12249                    GlobalRequest::CreateChildThread(
12250                        leader,
12251                        detpid,
12252                        0,
12253                        None,
12254                        libc::SIGCHLD,
12255                        None,
12256                        Some(DEFAULT_PRIORITY),
12257                    ),
12258                ),
12259            )
12260            .await;
12261        assert_eq!(
12262            create_response,
12263            (
12264                Some(worker_clock.as_nanos()),
12265                GlobalResponse::CreateChildThread(Some(old_mm.for_exec(detpid)))
12266            )
12267        );
12268        assert!(state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
12269        assert_eq!(
12270            state.post_exec_fd_blocking.lock().unwrap().get(&leader),
12271            Some(&fd_blocking)
12272        );
12273
12274        let late_old_request = state
12275            .receive_rpc(
12276                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12277                (
12278                    leader_clock.clone(),
12279                    old_mm,
12280                    GlobalRequest::RequestResources(Resources::new(leader), detpid),
12281                ),
12282            )
12283            .await;
12284        assert_eq!(late_old_request, (None, GlobalResponse::ThreadExited));
12285        let admitted_before_fence = state
12286            .recv_request_resources(
12287                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12288                detpid,
12289                Resources::new(leader),
12290                Some(old_mm),
12291            )
12292            .await;
12293        assert_eq!(
12294            admitted_before_fence,
12295            (SchedulerRpcResult::ThreadExited, None)
12296        );
12297        let late_old_deregister = state
12298            .receive_rpc(
12299                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12300                (
12301                    leader_clock.clone(),
12302                    old_mm,
12303                    GlobalRequest::DeregisterThread(ThreadDeregistration {
12304                        thread_start_entered: true,
12305                        dettid: leader,
12306                        detpid,
12307                        mm: old_mm,
12308                        timeslice_stats: TimesliceStats::default(),
12309                        syscall_count: 0,
12310                        chaos_epochs: Vec::new(),
12311                    }),
12312                ),
12313            )
12314            .await;
12315        assert_eq!(
12316            late_old_deregister,
12317            (None, GlobalResponse::DeregisterThread(()))
12318        );
12319        let duplicate_create = state
12320            .receive_rpc(
12321                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12322                (
12323                    fresh_local_time.clone(),
12324                    MmId::initial(leader),
12325                    GlobalRequest::CreateChildThread(
12326                        leader,
12327                        detpid,
12328                        0,
12329                        None,
12330                        libc::SIGCHLD,
12331                        None,
12332                        Some(DEFAULT_PRIORITY),
12333                    ),
12334                ),
12335            )
12336            .await;
12337        assert_eq!(duplicate_create, (None, GlobalResponse::ThreadExited));
12338
12339        {
12340            let scheduler = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
12341            assert!(!scheduler.thread_is_logically_killed(leader));
12342            assert!(scheduler.thread_is_logically_killed(worker));
12343            assert!(scheduler.thread_is_logically_killed(sibling));
12344            assert_eq!(scheduler.next_turns.len(), 1);
12345            assert!(scheduler.next_turns.contains_key(&leader));
12346            assert!(!scheduler.timeslices.contains_key(&leader));
12347            assert!(!scheduler.vfork_barrier_mentions(leader));
12348            assert!(!scheduler.vfork_barrier_mentions(sibling));
12349            assert!(matches!(leader_request.try_read(), Some(Err(_))));
12350            assert!(matches!(worker_request.try_read(), Some(Err(_))));
12351            assert!(matches!(sibling_request.try_read(), Some(Err(_))));
12352            assert!(
12353                scheduler
12354                    .child_tid_was_cleared(FutexID::private(old_mm, 0x5678), sibling.as_raw(),)
12355            );
12356        }
12357
12358        // Drive the real daemon through step2 rather than manually pre-filling
12359        // the replacement's response. This drains the destroyed leader's
12360        // physical removal and the same-raw-TID replacement admission before
12361        // StartNewThread supplies the fresh image's first request.
12362        let turn_sched = state.sched.clone();
12363        let turn_time = state.global_time.clone();
12364        let turn = tokio::spawn(async move {
12365            let last: Result<Resources, crate::scheduler::SkipTurn> =
12366                Err(crate::scheduler::SkipTurn);
12367            crate::scheduler::do_a_turn_blocking(turn_sched, turn_time, &last).await
12368        });
12369        let start_response = state
12370            .receive_rpc(
12371                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12372                (
12373                    fresh_local_time,
12374                    old_mm.for_exec(detpid),
12375                    GlobalRequest::StartNewThread(leader, detpid, None, None),
12376                ),
12377            )
12378            .await;
12379        assert!(
12380            turn.await
12381                .expect("replacement scheduler turn panicked")
12382                .is_ok(),
12383            "replacement leader did not survive the first step2 drain"
12384        );
12385        assert_eq!(
12386            start_response,
12387            (
12388                Some(worker_clock.as_nanos()),
12389                GlobalResponse::StartNewThread(None)
12390            )
12391        );
12392        {
12393            let scheduler = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
12394            assert_eq!(
12395                scheduler
12396                    .run_queue
12397                    .tids()
12398                    .filter(|dettid| **dettid == leader)
12399                    .count(),
12400                1
12401            );
12402            assert!(!scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(worker));
12403            assert!(!scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(sibling));
12404        }
12405        {
12406            let global_time = state.global_time.lock().unwrap();
12407            assert_eq!(global_time.as_nanos(), total_before);
12408            assert_eq!(global_time.threads_time(leader), worker_clock.as_nanos());
12409            assert!(!global_time.contains_thread(worker));
12410        }
12411
12412        let mark_response = state
12413            .receive_rpc(
12414                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12415                (
12416                    worker_clock,
12417                    old_mm.for_exec(detpid),
12418                    GlobalRequest::MarkPastFirstExecve(detpid, None, None),
12419                ),
12420            )
12421            .await;
12422        assert_eq!(
12423            mark_response.1,
12424            GlobalResponse::MarkPastFirstExecve(Box::new(fd_blocking))
12425        );
12426        assert!(state.post_exec_fd_blocking.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
12427    }

12429    #[tokio::test]
12430    async fn reloaded_post_exec_restores_prepared_input_aliases_once() {
12431        use nix::fcntl::OFlag;
12432        use reverie::Tool;
12433
12434        async fn start_image(
12435            tool: &Detcore,
12436            guest: &mut ExternalRegistrationGuest<'_>,
12437            expected_grants: &[ResourceID],
12438        ) {
12439            let state = guest.global;
12440            let tid = guest.thread.dettid;
12441            tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
12442                let mut start = std::pin::pin!(tool.handle_thread_start(guest));
12443                assert!(futures::poll!(start.as_mut()).is_pending());
12444                // Initial self-registration requests ParentContinue before
12445                // StartNewThread. Reload registration has no parent turn.
12446                // Drive these actual grants, without fabricating responses.
12447                let grants = async {
12448                    let mut last = Err(crate::scheduler::SkipTurn);
12449                    for expected in expected_grants {
12450                        let granted = crate::scheduler::do_a_turn_blocking(
12451                            state.sched.clone(),
12452                            state.global_time.clone(),
12453                            &last,
12454                        )
12455                        .await
12456                        .expect("image admission must receive its scheduler grant");
12457                        assert_eq!(granted.tid, tid);
12458                        assert!(granted.resources.contains_key(expected));
12459                        last = Ok(granted);
12460                    }
12461                };
12462                let (started, ()) = tokio::join!(start, grants);
12463                started.unwrap();
12464            })
12465            .await
12466            .expect("image admission must finish without guest instructions");
12467        }
12468
12469        let config = Config {
12470            sequentialize_threads: true,
12471            max_timeslice: None,
12472            ..Config::default()
12473        }
12474        .with_backend(|backend| {
12475            backend.needs_killed_thread_rpc_cancellation = true;
12476            backend.tool_shares_guest_descriptor_table = true;
12477        });
12478        let mut state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
12479        let leader = super::ROOT_DETPID;
12480        let tool = Detcore::new(reverie::Pid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()), &config);
12481
12482        // Use the real launch-input owner and its registered-root seed, in a
12483        // privately owned slot rather than the test harness's stdin.
12484        let reader: OwnedFd = std::fs::File::open("/dev/null").unwrap().into();
12485        let fd = reader.as_raw_fd();
12486        let input = reverie::InheritedInput::pipe(fd).unwrap();
12487        let identity = input.identity().clone();
12488        state.install_inherited_input(input.lease().unwrap());
12489        let (source, _writer) = input.into_reader_and_writer();
12490        // SAFETY: dup2 replaces only this test's owned destination.
12491        assert_eq!(unsafe { libc::dup2(source.as_raw_fd(), fd) }, fd);
12492        drop(source);
12493        let alias = reader.try_clone().unwrap();
12494        let cloexec = reader.try_clone().unwrap();
12495        let alias_fd = alias.as_raw_fd();
12496        let cloexec_fd = cloexec.as_raw_fd();
12497        // SAFETY: only the test-owned alias's descriptor flag is changed.
12498        assert_eq!(unsafe { libc::fcntl(alias_fd, libc::F_SETFD, 0) }, 0);
12499        let flags = |fd| {
12500            // SAFETY: both no-argument queries inspect owned descriptors.
12501            let result = unsafe {
12502                (
12503                    libc::fcntl(fd, libc::F_GETFL),
12504                    libc::fcntl(fd, libc::F_GETFD),
12505                )
12506            };
12507            assert!(result.0 >= 0 && result.1 >= 0);
12508            result
12509        };
12510        let kernel_before = [flags(fd), flags(alias_fd)];
12511        assert_eq!(
12512            kernel_before[0].0 & (libc::O_ACCMODE | libc::O_NONBLOCK),
12513            libc::O_RDONLY
12514        );
12515        assert_eq!(flags(cloexec_fd).1 & libc::FD_CLOEXEC, libc::FD_CLOEXEC);
12516
12517        let mut old = ExternalRegistrationGuest {
12518            global: &state,
12519            config: &config,
12520            thread: tool.init_thread_state(Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()), None),
12521            requests: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
12522            post_exec: true,
12523        };
12524        old.thread.detpid = Some(leader);
12525        start_image(
12526            &tool,
12527            &mut old,
12528            &[
12529                ResourceID::ParentContinue {
12530                    parent: leader,
12531                    child: leader,
12532                },
12533                ResourceID::MemAddrSpace(leader),
12534            ],
12535        )
12536        .await;
12537        tool.handle_post_exec(&mut old).await.unwrap();
12538        assert!(state.inherited_input.lock().unwrap().is_none());
12539        old.thread.dup_fd(fd, alias_fd, OFlag::empty()).unwrap();
12540        old.thread.dup_fd(fd, cloexec_fd, OFlag::O_CLOEXEC).unwrap();
12541        let origin = old.thread.file_metadata.lock().unwrap().file_handles[&fd]
12542            .inherited_external_read()
12543            .expect("the actual registered launch seed must establish read provenance");
12544        assert_eq!(
12545            (origin.dev, origin.inode, origin.rdev),
12546            (identity.dev(), identity.inode(), identity.rdev())
12547        );
12548        let old_mm = old.thread.mm_id;
12549        super::prepare_exec(&mut old, old_mm, Default::default(), Vec::new(), None).await;
12550        {
12551            let pending = state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap();
12552            let prepared = &pending[&leader].fd_blocking.inherited_reads;
12553            assert_eq!(
12554                prepared.keys().copied().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>(),
12555                BTreeSet::from([fd, alias_fd])
12556            );
12557            assert!(prepared.values().all(|entry| entry == &origin));
12558            assert!(!prepared.contains_key(&cloexec_fd));
12559        }
12560        // Model the physical successful-exec boundary: the old Tool state is
12561        // gone and Linux has closed the CLOEXEC alias. No native exec is claimed.
12562        drop(old);
12563        drop(cloexec);
12564        let mut successor = ExternalRegistrationGuest {
12565            global: &state,
12566            config: &config,
12567            thread: tool.init_thread_state(Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()), None),
12568            requests: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
12569            post_exec: true,
12570        };
12571        successor.thread.detpid = Some(leader);
12572        start_image(&tool, &mut successor, &[ResourceID::MemAddrSpace(leader)]).await;
12573        assert_eq!(successor.thread.mm_id, old_mm.for_exec(leader));
12574        assert!(state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
12575        assert_eq!(
12576            state.post_exec_fd_blocking.lock().unwrap()[&leader]
12577                .inherited_reads
12578                .len(),
12579            2
12580        );
12581        assert!(
12582            !successor
12583                .thread
12584                .file_metadata
12585                .lock()
12586                .unwrap()
12587                .file_handles
12588                .contains_key(&fd)
12589        );
12590
12591        // This is the actual Tool callback, not a raw completion-RPC check or
12592        // a direct metadata restore. Empty auxv deliberately excludes AT_RANDOM.
12593        tool.handle_post_exec(&mut successor).await.unwrap();
12594        assert!(state.post_exec_fd_blocking.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
12595        {
12596            let metadata = successor.thread.file_metadata.lock().unwrap();
12597            for slot in [fd, alias_fd] {
12598                let entry = metadata
12599                    .file_handles
12600                    .get(&slot)
12601                    .expect("post-exec must restore every prepared surviving input alias");
12602                assert_eq!(
12603                    entry.inherited_external_read(),
12604                    Some(origin.clone()),
12605                    "post-exec must restore transferred origin, not plain pipe discovery"
12606                );
12607                assert_eq!(entry.ty(), crate::fd::FdType::Pipe);
12608                assert!(!entry.is_nonblocking());
12609                assert!(!entry.physically_nonblocking());
12610                assert!(!entry.is_cloexec());
12611                assert_eq!(entry.resource(), origin.resource);
12612            }
12613            assert_eq!(
12614                metadata.file_handles[&fd].open_file_id(),
12615                metadata.file_handles[&alias_fd].open_file_id()
12616            );
12617            assert_eq!(metadata.file_handles[&fd].open_file_alias_count(), 2);
12618            assert!(!metadata.file_handles.contains_key(&cloexec_fd));
12619        }
12620        assert_eq!([flags(fd), flags(alias_fd)], kernel_before);
12621        let snapshot =
12622            || serde_json::to_value(&*successor.thread.file_metadata.lock().unwrap()).unwrap();
12623        let before_rpc = snapshot();
12624        let response = successor
12625            .send_rpc((
12626                successor.thread.thread_logical_time.clone(),
12627                successor.thread.mm_id,
12628                GlobalRequest::GlobalTimeLowerBound,
12629            ))
12630            .await;
12631        assert!(matches!(
12632            response.1,
12633            GlobalResponse::GlobalTimeLowerBound(_)
12634        ));
12635        assert_eq!(
12636            snapshot(),
12637            before_rpc,
12638            "ordinary admitted RPC must leave restored metadata unchanged"
12639        );
12640        assert!(state.post_exec_fd_blocking.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
12641        assert!(state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
12642        let requests = successor.requests.lock().unwrap();
12643        assert_eq!(
12644            requests
12645                .iter()
12646                .filter(|r| matches!(r, GlobalRequest::MarkPastFirstExecve(..)))
12647                .count(),
12648            1
12649        );
12650        assert!(matches!(
12651            requests.first(),
12652            Some(GlobalRequest::CreateChildThread(..))
12653        ));
12654        assert!(matches!(
12655            requests.get(1),
12656            Some(GlobalRequest::StartNewThread(..))
12657        ));
12658        assert!(matches!(
12659            requests.last(),
12660            Some(GlobalRequest::GlobalTimeLowerBound)
12661        ));
12662    }

12664    #[tokio::test]
12665    async fn post_exec_deletes_armed_disarmed_and_non_notifying_timers() {
12666        use reverie::Tool;
12667
12668        let config = Config {
12669            sequentialize_threads: true,
12670            // This test enters one callback while the caller owns its turn;
12671            // no guest instructions or PMU timer are needed to drive it.
12672            max_timeslice: None,
12673            ..Config::default()
12674        }
12675        .with_backend(|backend| {
12676            backend.needs_killed_thread_rpc_cancellation = true;
12677        });
12678        let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
12679        let leader = DetTid::from_raw(17);
12680        let detpid = DetPid::from_raw(17);
12681        state
12682            .sched
12683            .lock()
12684            .unwrap()
12685            .thread_tree
12686            .add_child(leader, leader, true);
12687        let next_request = Ivar::new();
12688        install_test_registration(&state, leader, next_request.clone());
12689        let tool = Detcore::new(reverie::Pid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()), &config);
12690        let mut thread = tool.init_thread_state(Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()), None);
12691        thread.detpid = Some(detpid);
12692        // The exec's own syscall, intercepted and counted, as a backend that
12693        // traces the guest counts it before post-exec. (A backend that starts
12694        // the guest already executing reaches its first post-exec with nothing
12695        // counted, and post-exec charges the execve itself.)
12696        thread.stats.count_syscall();
12697        thread.thread_logical_time.add_syscall_with_cost(137);
12698        let mut guest = ExternalRegistrationGuest {
12699            global: &state,
12700            config: &config,
12701            thread,
12702            requests: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
12703            post_exec: true,
12704        };
12705        let t = LogicalTime::from_nanos;
12706        let [periodic, disarmed, silent] = {
12707            let mut timers = guest.thread.posix_timers.lock().unwrap();
12708            let periodic = timers.create(Some(libc::SIGUSR2), None, None);
12709            let disarmed = timers.create(Some(libc::SIGALRM), None, None);
12710            let silent = timers.create(None, None, None);
12711            timers.settime(periodic, 50, Some(t(100)), t(0));
12712            timers.settime(silent, 0, Some(t(200)), t(0));
12713            [periodic, disarmed, silent]
12714        };
12715
12716        // Drive the production callback, including its actual global RPCs.
12717        // Removing its clear_for_exec call must leave these IDs live and fail.
12718        // A second successful exec also exercises deletion of an empty table.
12719        for _ in 0..2 {
12720            let old_mm = guest.thread.mm_id;
12721            super::prepare_exec(&mut guest, old_mm, Default::default(), Vec::new(), None).await;
12722            guest.thread.mm_id = old_mm.for_exec(detpid);
12723            let before = guest.thread.thread_logical_time.as_nanos();
12724            tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), tool.handle_post_exec(&mut guest))
12725                .await
12726                .expect("post-exec must finish within the caller's scheduler turn")
12727                .unwrap();
12728            assert_eq!(guest.thread.thread_logical_time.as_nanos(), before);
12729            assert!(
12730                next_request.try_read().is_none(),
12731                "post-exec unexpectedly yielded"
12732            );
12733            let mut timers = guest.thread.posix_timers.lock().unwrap();
12734            for id in [periodic, disarmed, silent] {
12735                assert!(!timers.contains(id), "post-exec retained POSIX timer {id}");
12736                assert_eq!(timers.gettime(id, t(10)), None);
12737                assert_eq!(timers.settime(id, 0, Some(t(300)), t(10)), None);
12738                assert_eq!(timers.signal(id), None);
12739                assert!(!timers.remove(id));
12740            }
12741        }
12742        let mut timers = guest.thread.posix_timers.lock().unwrap();
12743        let new = timers.create(Some(libc::SIGUSR1), None, None);
12744        assert_eq!(new, 3);
12745        assert_eq!(timers.settime(new, 0, Some(t(300)), t(10)), Some((0, 0)));
12746        assert_eq!(timers.gettime(new, t(20)), Some((280, 0)));
12747    }

12749    /// A state like [`cancellation_test_state`]'s for a run that declared
12750    /// `launcher` as the image the kernel execs in the guest's place.
12751    fn exec_record_test_state(
12752        sequentialize_threads: bool,
12753        launcher: &std::path::Path,
12754    ) -> (Config, GlobalState, DetTid, DetPid) {
12755        let config = Config {
12756            sequentialize_threads,
12757            launch_image: Some(crate::LaunchImage {
12758                exe: None,
12759                launcher: Some(launcher.to_path_buf()),
12760            }),
12761            ..Config::default()
12762        };
12763        let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
12764        let dettid = DetTid::from_raw(17);
12765        state
12766            .sched
12767            .lock()
12768            .unwrap()
12769            .thread_tree
12770            .add_child(dettid, dettid, true);
12771        (config, state, dettid, DetPid::from_raw(17))
12772    }

12774    /// An exec's record stands only where the kernel's link, as the new
12775    /// image read it, names the recorded file or the launcher the run
12776    /// declared; it is what other processes then read for the process, and a
12777    /// dropped record leaves them nothing. Without sequentialized threads no
12778    /// record is kept.
12779    #[tokio::test]
12780    async fn an_exec_record_stands_only_where_the_kernel_names_it_or_the_launcher() {
12781        use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
12782        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
12783        let directory = std::fs::canonicalize(directory.path()).unwrap();
12784        let (image, launcher, other) = (
12785            directory.join("image"),
12786            directory.join("launcher"),
12787            directory.join("other"),
12788        );
12789        for file in [&image, &launcher, &other] {
12790            std::fs::write(file, file.as_os_str().as_encoded_bytes()).unwrap();
12791        }
12792        let identity = |path: &std::path::Path| {
12793            let meta = std::fs::metadata(path).unwrap();
12794            (meta.dev(), meta.ino())
12795        };
12796        let record = crate::exec_record::ExecRecord::at(std::path::Path::new("/"), &image).unwrap();
12797        for (sequentialize, kernel, kept) in [
12798            (true, identity(&image), true),
12799            (true, identity(&launcher), true),
12800            (true, identity(&other), false),
12801            (false, identity(&image), false),
12802        ] {
12803            let (config, state, leader, detpid) = exec_record_test_state(sequentialize, &launcher);
12804            install_test_registration(&state, leader, Ivar::new());
12805            let clock = DetTime::new(&config);
12806            let mm = MmId::initial(detpid);
12807            let tid = reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw());
12808            let prepared = ExecFdState {
12809                exe: Some(record.clone()),
12810                ..Default::default()
12811            };
12812            let response = state
12813                .receive_rpc(
12814                    tid,
12815                    (
12816                        clock.clone(),
12817                        mm,
12818                        GlobalRequest::PrepareExec(detpid, mm, Box::new(prepared)),
12819                    ),
12820                )
12821                .await;
12822            assert_eq!(response.1, GlobalResponse::PrepareExec(()));
12823            let response = state
12824                .receive_rpc(
12825                    tid,
12826                    (
12827                        clock,
12828                        mm.for_exec(detpid),
12829                        GlobalRequest::MarkPastFirstExecve(detpid, None, Some(kernel)),
12830                    ),
12831                )
12832                .await;
12833            let GlobalResponse::MarkPastFirstExecve(overrides) = response.1 else {
12834                panic!("unexpected response {:?}", response.1);
12835            };
12836            let expected = kept.then(|| record.clone());
12837            assert_eq!(overrides.exe, expected, "{sequentialize} {kernel:?}");
12838            assert_eq!(
12839                state.exec_images.lock().unwrap().get(&detpid).cloned(),
12840                expected,
12841                "{sequentialize} {kernel:?}"
12842            );
12843        }
12844    }

12846    /// The launch's first image goes to the registered root's first
12847    /// completed image only: another thread's completion, first or not,
12848    /// gets none, and the root's later images get none from the launch. The
12849    /// root's record stands without sequentialized threads too, as it comes
12850    /// from no preparation.
12851    #[tokio::test]
12852    async fn the_launch_image_goes_to_the_registered_roots_first_image_only() {
12853        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
12854        let directory = std::fs::canonicalize(directory.path()).unwrap();
12855        let (image, launcher) = (directory.join("image"), directory.join("launcher"));
12856        for file in [&image, &launcher] {
12857            std::fs::write(file, file.as_os_str().as_encoded_bytes()).unwrap();
12858        }
12859        let record = crate::exec_record::ExecRecord::at(std::path::Path::new("/"), &image).unwrap();
12860        for sequentialize in [true, false] {
12861            let config = Config {
12862                sequentialize_threads: sequentialize,
12863                launch_image: Some(crate::LaunchImage {
12864                    exe: Some(image.clone()),
12865                    launcher: Some(launcher.clone()),
12866                }),
12867                ..Config::default()
12868            };
12869            let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
12870            let (root, other) = (DetTid::from_raw(17), DetTid::from_raw(23));
12871            for tid in [root, other] {
12872                state
12873                    .sched
12874                    .lock()
12875                    .unwrap()
12876                    .thread_tree
12877                    .add_child(tid, tid, true);
12878                install_test_registration(&state, tid, Ivar::new());
12879            }
12880            state.root_dettid.set(root).unwrap();
12881            let clock = DetTime::new(&config);
12882            let mark = |tid: DetTid| {
12883                let process = DetPid::from_raw(tid.as_raw());
12884                (
12885                    reverie::Tid::from_raw(tid.as_raw()),
12886                    (
12887                        clock.clone(),
12888                        MmId::initial(process),
12889                        GlobalRequest::MarkPastFirstExecve(process, None, None),
12890                    ),
12891                )
12892            };
12893            for (tid, expected) in [(other, None), (root, Some(&record)), (root, None)] {
12894                let (from, request) = mark(tid);
12895                let response = state.receive_rpc(from, request).await;
12896                let GlobalResponse::MarkPastFirstExecve(overrides) = response.1 else {
12897                    panic!("unexpected response {:?}", response.1);
12898                };
12899                assert_eq!(overrides.exe.as_ref(), expected, "{sequentialize} {tid:?}");
12900            }
12901        }
12902    }

12904    #[tokio::test]
12905    async fn only_successful_exec_cancels_posix_deadlines() {
12906        let (config, state, leader, detpid) = cancellation_test_state();
12907        install_test_registration(&state, leader, Ivar::new());
12908        let clock = DetTime::new(&config);
12909        let mm = MmId::initial(detpid);
12910        let deadline = LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_000_000);
12911        {
12912            let mut sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
12913            sched.register_alarm(
12914                detpid,
12915                leader,
12916                LogicalTime::ZERO,
12917                deadline,
12918                LogicalTime::ZERO,
12919                Signal::SIGALRM,
12920            );
12921            sched.register_posix_timer(
12922                detpid,
12923                crate::scheduler::timed_waiters::SignalTarget::Process(leader),
12924                0,
12925                Some(deadline),
12926                deadline,
12927                Signal::SIGUSR2.into(),
12928            );
12929        }
12930        let before: Vec<_> = state
12931            .sched
12932            .lock()
12933            .unwrap()
12934            .blocked
12935            .timed_waiters
12936            .iter()
12937            .collect();
12938        for request in [
12939            GlobalRequest::PrepareExec(detpid, mm, Default::default()),
12940            GlobalRequest::CancelExec(detpid),
12941            GlobalRequest::PrepareExec(detpid, mm, Default::default()),
12942        ] {
12943            state
12944                .receive_rpc(
12945                    reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12946                    (clock.clone(), mm, request),
12947                )
12948                .await;
12949            assert_eq!(
12950                state
12951                    .sched
12952                    .lock()
12953                    .unwrap()
12954                    .blocked
12955                    .timed_waiters
12956                    .iter()
12957                    .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
12958                before
12959            );
12960        }
12961
12962        let response = state
12963            .receive_rpc(
12964                reverie::Tid::from_raw(leader.as_raw()),
12965                (
12966                    clock,
12967                    mm.for_exec(detpid),
12968                    GlobalRequest::MarkPastFirstExecve(detpid, None, None),
12969                ),
12970            )
12971            .await;
12972        assert_eq!(
12973            response.1,
12974            GlobalResponse::MarkPastFirstExecve(Default::default())
12975        );
12976        let sched = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
12977        assert_eq!(
12978            sched.blocked.timed_waiters.alarm_state(detpid),
12979            Some((deadline, LogicalTime::ZERO))
12980        );
12981        assert_eq!(sched.blocked.timed_waiters.iter().count(), 1);
12982    }

13087            )
13088            .await;
13089        assert!(state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
13090
13091        state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap().insert(
13092            detpid,
13093            PendingExecState {
13094                caller: leader,
13095                process: detpid,
13096                mm: MmId::initial(detpid),
13097                fd_blocking: Default::default(),
13098            },
13099        );
13100        state.post_exec_fd_blocking.lock().unwrap().insert(
13101            leader,
13102            ExecFdState::from([42].into_iter().collect::<ExecFdBlockingOverrides>()),
13103        );
13104        state.complete_physical_process_exit(detpid.as_raw());
13105        assert!(state.pending_exec_states.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
13106        assert!(state.post_exec_fd_blocking.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
13107    }

13109    #[test]
13110    fn unsupported_syscall_report_duplicate_is_close_on_exec() {
13111        let mut descriptors = [-1; 2];
13112        assert_eq!(
13113            unsafe { libc::pipe2(descriptors.as_mut_ptr(), libc::O_CLOEXEC) },
13114            0
13115        );
13116        // SAFETY: pipe2 initialized both descriptors and transfers ownership.
13117        let _reader = unsafe { OwnedFd::from_raw_fd(descriptors[0]) };
13118        let writer = unsafe { OwnedFd::from_raw_fd(descriptors[1]) };
13119        let config = Config {
13120            unsupported_syscall_report_fd: Some(writer.as_raw_fd()),
13121            ..Config::default()
13122        };
13123
13124        let state = GlobalState::initialize(&config, false);
13125        let duplicate = state
13126            .unsupported_syscall_report_fd
13127            .as_ref()
13128            .expect("report writer should be duplicated")
13129            .lock()
13130            .unwrap();
13131        let flags = unsafe { libc::fcntl(duplicate.as_raw_fd(), libc::F_GETFD) };
13132        assert_ne!(flags, -1);
13133        assert_ne!(flags & libc::FD_CLOEXEC, 0);
13134    }

13136    // AUTONOMOUS-BOT-IMPLEMENTED
13137    // TODO-HUMAN-REVIEW(PR-1056): Deterministic st_dev remapping test.
13138    #[test]
13139    fn device_pool_remaps_deterministically() {
13140        use super::DevicePool;
13141
13142        // Raw device numbers a guest might observe; the procfs/tmpfs ones
13143        // (large anon-bdev values) are exactly what drifts between runs.
13144        let raw_root = 0x20; // e.g. a real block device
13145        let raw_proc_run1 = 3_145_792; // anon bdev in run 1
13146        let raw_proc_run2 = 3_145_788; // same procfs, different number in run 2
13147
13148        // Run 1: observe root then proc.
13149        let mut pool1 = DevicePool::new();
13150        let root1 = pool1.determinize(raw_root);
13151        let proc1 = pool1.determinize(raw_proc_run1);
13152        // Run 2: same observation order, different raw proc number.
13153        let mut pool2 = DevicePool::new();
13154        let root2 = pool2.determinize(raw_root);
13155        let proc2 = pool2.determinize(raw_proc_run2);
13156
13157        // The synthetic ids depend only on first-observation order, so they are
13158        // identical across the two runs despite the raw proc number differing.
13159        assert_eq!(root1, root2);
13160        assert_eq!(proc1, proc2);
13161
13162        // Distinct raw devices get distinct ids; ids start at 1 (never 0).
13163        assert_ne!(root1, proc1);
13164        assert_eq!(root1, 1);
13165        assert_eq!(proc1, 2);
13166
13167        // Re-observing a raw device is stable within a run.
13168        assert_eq!(pool1.determinize(raw_root), root1);
13169        assert_eq!(pool1.determinize(raw_proc_run1), proc1);
13170    }

13302    async fn late_resource_request_after_logical_kill_is_cancelled() {
13303        let (config, state, dettid, detpid) = cancellation_test_state();
13304        install_test_registration(&state, dettid, Ivar::new());
13305        let mut current_time = DetTime::new(&config);
13306        current_time.add_syscall();
13307        state.global_time.lock().unwrap().update_global_time(
13308            dettid,
13309            current_time.as_nanos(),
13310            LogicalTime::ZERO,
13311        );
13312        state
13313            .sched
13314            .lock()
13315            .unwrap()
13316            .logically_kill_thread(&dettid, &detpid, MmId::initial(detpid));
13317        let (global_before, thread_before) = {
13318            let global_time = state.global_time.lock().unwrap();
13319            (global_time.as_nanos(), global_time.threads_time(dettid))
13320        };
13321        let mut late_time = current_time;
13322        late_time.add_syscall();
13323
13324        let response = state
13325            .receive_rpc(
13326                reverie::Tid::from_raw(dettid.as_raw()),
13327                (
13328                    late_time,
13329                    MmId::initial(dettid),
13330                    GlobalRequest::RequestResources(Resources::new(dettid), detpid),
13331                ),
13332            )
13333            .await;
13334
13335        assert_eq!(response, (None, GlobalResponse::ThreadExited));
13336        assert!(!state.sched.lock().unwrap().next_turns.contains_key(&dettid));
13337        let global_time = state.global_time.lock().unwrap();
13338        assert_eq!(global_time.as_nanos(), global_before);
13339        assert_eq!(global_time.threads_time(dettid), thread_before);
13340    }

13343    async fn duplicate_deregistration_is_acknowledged_without_clock_or_scheduler_mutation() {
13344        let (config, state, dettid, detpid) = cancellation_test_state();
13345        install_test_registration(&state, dettid, Ivar::new());
13346        let mut current_time = DetTime::new(&config);
13347        current_time.add_syscall();
13348        state.global_time.lock().unwrap().update_global_time(
13349            dettid,
13350            current_time.as_nanos(),
13351            LogicalTime::ZERO,
13352        );
13353        state
13354            .sched
13355            .lock()
13356            .unwrap()
13357            .logically_kill_thread(&dettid, &detpid, MmId::initial(detpid));
13358        let (global_before, thread_before) = {
13359            let global_time = state.global_time.lock().unwrap();
13360            (global_time.as_nanos(), global_time.threads_time(dettid))
13361        };
13362        let mut late_time = current_time;
13363        late_time.add_syscall();
13364        let mut final_stats = TimesliceStats::default();
13365        final_stats.record(7);
13366
13367        let first_response = state
13368            .receive_rpc(
13369                reverie::Tid::from_raw(dettid.as_raw()),
13370                (
13371                    late_time.clone(),
13372                    MmId::initial(dettid),
13373                    GlobalRequest::DeregisterThread(ThreadDeregistration {
13374                        thread_start_entered: true,
13375                        dettid,
13376                        detpid,
13377                        mm: MmId::initial(detpid),
13378                        timeslice_stats: final_stats,
13379                        syscall_count: 17,
13380                        chaos_epochs: Vec::new(),
13381                    }),
13382                ),
13383            )
13384            .await;
13385        assert_eq!(first_response, (None, GlobalResponse::DeregisterThread(())));
13386        assert_eq!(
13387            state
13388                .sched
13389                .lock()
13390                .unwrap()
13391                .per_thread_timeslice
13392                .get(&dettid),
13393            Some(&final_stats)
13394        );
13395        assert_eq!(
13396            state.sched.lock().unwrap().per_thread_syscalls.get(&dettid),
13397            Some(&17)
13398        );
13399
13400        late_time.add_syscall();
13401        let duplicate_response = state
13402            .receive_rpc(
13403                reverie::Tid::from_raw(dettid.as_raw()),
13404                (
13405                    late_time,
13406                    MmId::initial(dettid),
13407                    GlobalRequest::DeregisterThread(ThreadDeregistration {
13408                        thread_start_entered: true,
13409                        dettid,
13410                        detpid,
13411                        mm: MmId::initial(detpid),
13412                        timeslice_stats: final_stats,
13413                        syscall_count: 99,
13414                        chaos_epochs: Vec::new(),
13415                    }),
13416                ),
13417            )
13418            .await;
13419        assert_eq!(
13420            duplicate_response,
13421            (None, GlobalResponse::DeregisterThread(()))
13422        );
13423        assert_eq!(
13424            state
13425                .sched
13426                .lock()
13427                .unwrap()
13428                .per_thread_timeslice
13429                .get(&dettid),
13430            Some(&final_stats)
13431        );
13432        assert_eq!(
13433            state.sched.lock().unwrap().per_thread_syscalls.get(&dettid),
13434            Some(&17),
13435            "a duplicate deregistration must not double-count or replace final accounting"
13436        );
13437        let summary = state
13438            .sched
13439            .lock()
13440            .unwrap()
13441            .generate_partial_run_summary(None)
13442            .unwrap();
13443        assert_eq!(summary.syscalls, Some(17));
13444        assert!(!state.sched.lock().unwrap().next_turns.contains_key(&dettid));
13445        let global_time = state.global_time.lock().unwrap();
13446        assert_eq!(global_time.as_nanos(), global_before);
13447        assert_eq!(global_time.threads_time(dettid), thread_before);
13448    }

13706    async fn pending_futex_request_woken_by_logical_kill_is_terminal() {
13707        let (config, state, dettid, detpid) = cancellation_test_state();
13708        install_test_registration(&state, dettid, Ivar::new());
13709        let request = state.receive_rpc(
13710            reverie::Tid::from_raw(dettid.as_raw()),
13711            (
13712                DetTime::new(&config),
13713                MmId::initial(dettid),
13714                GlobalRequest::FutexAction(
13715                    dettid,
13716                    FutexAction::WaitRequest(None, None),
13717                    FutexID::private(MmId::initial(detpid), 0x1000),
13718                    0,
13719                    u32::MAX,
13720                ),
13721            ),
13722        );
13723        let kill_after_wait = async {
13724            while state.sched.lock().unwrap().blocked.futex_waiters.is_empty() {
13725                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
13726            }
13727            state.sched.lock().unwrap().logically_kill_thread(
13728                &dettid,
13729                &detpid,
13730                MmId::initial(detpid),
13731            );
13732        };
13733
13734        let (response, ()) = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
13735            tokio::join!(request, kill_after_wait)
13736        })
13737        .await
13738        .expect("futex teardown did not wake the blocked RPC");
13739        assert_eq!(response, (None, GlobalResponse::ThreadExited));
13740    }

13742    #[tokio::test]
13743    async fn parent_continue_propagates_terminal_scheduler_cancellation() {
13744        let (config, state, parent, detpid) = cancellation_test_state();
13745        let parent_request = Ivar::new();
13746        install_test_registration(&state, parent, parent_request.clone());
13747        let child = DetTid::from_raw(18);
13748        let physical_pid = std::process::id() as i32;
13749        let physical_tid = unsafe { libc::syscall(libc::SYS_gettid) as i32 };
13750        let request = state.receive_rpc(
13751            reverie::Tid::from_raw(parent.as_raw()),
13752            (
13753                DetTime::new(&config),
13754                MmId::initial(parent),
13755                GlobalRequest::CreateChildThread(
13756                    child,
13757                    detpid,
13758                    0,
13759                    None,
13760                    libc::SIGCHLD,
13761                    Some((physical_pid, physical_tid)),
13762                    Some(DEFAULT_PRIORITY),
13763                ),
13764            ),
13765        );
13766        let kill_after_parent_parks = async {
13767            while parent_request.try_read().is_none() {
13768                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
13769            }
13770            let mut scheduler = state.sched.lock().unwrap();
13771            let (registered_mm, registered_pid, registered_tid) = scheduler
13772                .physical_thread_identity(child)
13773                .expect("parent registration must install the child pidfd before continuing");
13774            assert_eq!(
13775                registered_mm,
13776                MmId::for_clone(MmId::initial(parent), child, false)
13777            );
13778            assert_eq!(
13779                (registered_pid, registered_tid),
13780                (physical_pid, physical_tid)
13781            );
13782            scheduler.logically_kill_thread(&parent, &detpid, MmId::initial(detpid));
13783        };
13784
13785        let (response, ()) = tokio::join!(request, kill_after_parent_parks);
13786        assert_eq!(response, (None, GlobalResponse::ThreadExited));
13787    }

13862    /// A deterministic inode must be minted from the monotonic counter, never
13863    /// derived from the host inode's bits. This is the behavioural half of the
13864    /// guarantee whose static half is `DetInode` being a newtype: even for a
13865    /// large, realistic host inode the det value stays small, so a leaked host
13866    /// inode is distinguishable from a genuine det one.
13867    #[test]
13868    fn det_inodes_are_minted_not_passed_through() {
13869        use crate::types::DetInode;
13870
13871        let mut pool = super::InodePool::new();
13872        let t = LogicalTime::from_nanos(0);
13873        let seen = super::ObservedMtime::Unobserved;
13874
13875        // 221_742_951 is the value observed leaking into FileContents.
13876        let host_a = crate::types::RawInode::new(33, 221_742_951);
13877        let host_b = crate::types::RawInode::new(33, 998_877_665);
13878        let (a, _) = pool.add_inode(host_a, seen, t);
13879        let (b, _) = pool.add_inode(host_b, seen, t);
13880
13881        assert_ne!(
13882            a.as_raw(),
13883            host_a.ino,
13884            "det inode must not be the host inode"
13885        );
13886        assert_ne!(
13887            b.as_raw(),
13888            host_b.ino,
13889            "det inode must not be the host inode"
13890        );
13891        assert_eq!(
13892            a,
13893            crate::consts::DET_INODE_OFFSET,
13894            "minting starts above the fixed stdio inodes"
13895        );
13896        assert_eq!(b, DetInode::mint(9001), "minting is monotonic");
13897
13898        // Re-determinizing the same host inode is stable, not a fresh mint.
13899        let (a_again, _) = pool.add_inode(host_a, seen, t);
13900        assert_eq!(a, a_again, "mapping must be stable per host inode");
13901    }

13903    /// <https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3840>: a filesystem such as
13904    /// ext4 or XFS gives a freed inode to a new file, and whether it does
13905    /// differs between runs. The same guest steps (number a file, remove its
13906    /// last name, create another file, look it up) must number the new file,
13907    /// and every file after it, the same way whether or not the host reused
13908    /// the inode, however the new file is first reached.
13909    #[test]
13910    fn a_host_reusing_a_freed_inode_does_not_renumber_the_new_file() {
13911        use super::InodeSighting::Descriptor;
13912        use super::InodeSighting::Name;
13913        use crate::types::DetInode;
13914        use crate::types::RawInode;
13915
13916        let t = LogicalTime::from_nanos(0);
13917        let seen = super::ObservedMtime::Unobserved;
13918        const EXT4: u64 = 2049;
13919        let old = RawInode::new(EXT4, 12);
13920        let fresh = RawInode::new(EXT4, 13);
13921        // `opened` says whether the new file is created by an `open`, which
13922        // discards a retired mapping, before its first numbering request.
13923        let steps = |new: RawInode, opened: bool, first: super::InodeSighting| {
13924            let mut pool = super::InodePool::new();
13925            let old_number = pool.add_sighted_inode(old, seen, t, Name).0;
13926            pool.retire(old);
13927            if opened {
13928                pool.forget_retired(new);
13929            }
13930            let new_number = pool.add_sighted_inode(new, seen, t, first).0;
13931            let listed = pool.add_sighted_inode(new, seen, t, Name).0;
13932            let later: Vec<DetInode> = [RawInode::new(EXT4, 40), RawInode::new(EXT4, 41)]
13933                .into_iter()
13934                .map(|raw| pool.add_sighted_inode(raw, seen, t, Name).0)
13935                .collect();
13936            (old_number, new_number, listed, later)
13937        };
13938        for (opened, first) in [(true, Descriptor), (true, Name), (false, Name)] {
13939            let reused = steps(old, opened, first);
13940            let not_reused = steps(fresh, opened, first);
13941            assert_eq!(
13942                reused, not_reused,
13943                "opened={opened} first={first:?}: reuse changed a number"
13944            );
13945            let (old_number, new_number, listed, _) = reused;
13946            assert_ne!(old_number, new_number, "the new file took the old number");
13947            assert_eq!(new_number, listed, "the new file's number is stable");
13948        }
13949    }

13951    /// An unlinked file reached through a descriptor (open, unlink, fstat)
13952    /// keeps its number and its mtime updates, as on Linux, until a name shows
13953    /// that the host gave its inode to another file. A path that finds no
13954    /// link (`/proc/self/fd/N`) is a `Descriptor` sighting.
13955    #[test]
13956    fn an_unlinked_file_keeps_its_number_through_its_descriptors() {
13957        use super::InodeSighting::Descriptor;
13958        use super::InodeSighting::Name;
13959        use crate::types::RawInode;
13960
13961        let t = LogicalTime::from_nanos(0);
13962        let seen = super::ObservedMtime::Unobserved;
13963        let raw = RawInode::new(2049, 12);
13964        let mut pool = super::InodePool::new();
13965        let (number, _) = pool.add_sighted_inode(raw, seen, t, Name);
13966        pool.retire(raw);
13967        assert_eq!(pool.add_sighted_inode(raw, seen, t, Descriptor).0, number);
13968        let written = LogicalTime::from_nanos(7_000);
13969        pool.set_mtime(raw, written);
13970        assert_eq!(
13971            pool.add_sighted_inode(raw, seen, t, Descriptor),
13972            (number, written),
13973            "a write through the descriptor reached the retired file"
13974        );
13975        let (reused, _) = pool.add_sighted_inode(raw, seen, t, Name);
13976        assert_ne!(reused, number, "a name of a retired inode is another file");
13977        assert_eq!(
13978            pool.add_sighted_inode(raw, seen, t, Descriptor).0,
13979            reused,
13980            "descriptors now reach the new file"
13981        );
13982        // Without a retire, a name finds the live mapping, as before.
13983        let other = RawInode::new(2049, 99);
13984        let (live, _) = pool.add_sighted_inode(other, seen, t, Descriptor);
13985        assert_eq!(pool.add_sighted_inode(other, seen, t, Name).0, live);
13986    }
13987
13988    /// A write's mtime update can reach a file before anything numbers it
13989    /// (`echo x > f`, then `rm f`). The pending mtime must stay with that file,
13990    /// for a descriptor that still reaches it, and must not reach the next
13991    /// file the host gives the inode (claude review of
13992    /// <https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3849>, P2-2).
13993    #[test]
13994    fn a_pending_mtime_stays_with_its_file_after_the_last_name_goes() {
13995        use super::InodeSighting::Descriptor;
13996        use super::InodeSighting::Name;
13997        use crate::types::RawInode;
13998
13999        let t = LogicalTime::from_nanos(0);
14000        let seen = super::ObservedMtime::Unobserved;
14001        let old = RawInode::new(2049, 12);
14002        let fresh = RawInode::new(2049, 13);
14003        let written = LogicalTime::from_nanos(7_000);
14004        // The next file is created by an open, or first seen in a listing.
14005        let next_file = |new: RawInode, opened: bool| {
14006            let mut pool = super::InodePool::new();
14007            pool.set_mtime(old, written);
14008            pool.retire(old);
14009            if opened {
14010                pool.forget_retired(new);
14011            }
14012            pool.add_sighted_inode(new, seen, t, Name)
14013        };
14014        for opened in [true, false] {
14015            assert_eq!(
14016                next_file(old, opened),
14017                next_file(fresh, opened),
14018                "opened={opened}: the reused inode inherited the removed file's mtime"
14019            );
14020        }
14021
14022        // Through a remaining descriptor, the removed file keeps its mtime,
14023        // and later writes through it reach it.
14024        let mut pool = super::InodePool::new();
14025        pool.set_mtime(old, written);
14026        pool.retire(old);
14027        let (number, mtime) = pool.add_sighted_inode(old, seen, t, Descriptor);
14028        assert_eq!(mtime, written);
14029        let rewritten = LogicalTime::from_nanos(9_000);
14030        pool.set_mtime(old, rewritten);
14031        assert_eq!(
14032            pool.add_sighted_inode(old, seen, t, Descriptor),
14033            (number, rewritten)
14034        );
14035        // It was numbered as retired: a name is another file.
14036        let (other, _) = pool.add_sighted_inode(old, seen, t, Name);
14037        assert_ne!(other, number);
14038    }

14040    /// A directory stream snapshots the whole directory at its first
14041    /// `getdents` and can return an entry after the entry's file lost its
14042    /// last name, while a descriptor still holds that file. Such an entry is
14043    /// not a new file, so it must not renumber the held one; an entry from a
14044    /// snapshot taken after the retirement is (codex review of
14045    /// <https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3849>, P1).
14046    #[test]
14047    fn a_stale_directory_entry_does_not_renumber_a_held_file() {
14048        use super::InodeSighting::Descriptor;
14049        use super::InodeSighting::Listed;
14050        use super::InodeSighting::Name;
14051        use crate::types::RawInode;
14052
14053        let t = LogicalTime::from_nanos(0);
14054        let seen = super::ObservedMtime::Unobserved;
14055        let raw = RawInode::new(2049, 12);
14056        let mut pool = super::InodePool::new();
14057        let (number, _) = pool.add_sighted_inode(raw, seen, t, Name);
14058        let before = pool.retirements;
14059        pool.retire(raw);
14060        assert_eq!(
14061            pool.add_sighted_inode(raw, seen, t, Listed(before)).0,
14062            number
14063        );
14064        assert_eq!(pool.add_sighted_inode(raw, seen, t, Descriptor).0, number);
14065        let after = pool.retirements;
14066        let (reused, _) = pool.add_sighted_inode(raw, seen, t, Listed(after));
14067        assert_ne!(
14068            reused, number,
14069            "a snapshot taken after the retirement shows a new file"
14070        );
14071    }
14072
14073    /// A snapshot entry must name the file that held the inode when the
14074    /// snapshot was taken, even after a later file the host gave the freed
14075    /// inode discarded that file's retirement. Codex re-review of
14076    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3849, P1 (Claude re-review
14077    /// P2-A): number F, take a snapshot, unlink F, create and number G, then
14078    /// read F's cached entry; reuse and a fresh inode must agree on every
14079    /// number, whether or not F was numbered before the snapshot.
14080    #[test]
14081    fn a_stale_directory_entry_keeps_its_file_after_the_inode_is_reused() {
14082        use super::InodeSighting::Listed;
14083        use super::InodeSighting::Name;
14084        use crate::types::DetInode;
14085        use crate::types::RawInode;
14086
14087        let t = LogicalTime::from_nanos(0);
14088        let seen = super::ObservedMtime::Unobserved;
14089        let f = RawInode::new(2049, 12);
14090        let fresh = RawInode::new(2049, 13);
14091        let history = |g: RawInode, numbered_first: bool| -> Vec<DetInode> {
14092            let mut pool = super::InodePool::new();
14093            let mut numbers = Vec::new();
14094            if numbered_first {
14095                numbers.push(pool.add_sighted_inode(f, seen, t, Name).0);
14096            }
14097            let snapshot = pool.retirements;
14098            pool.retire(f);
14099            pool.forget_retired(g); // G's open.
14100            numbers.push(pool.add_sighted_inode(g, seen, t, Name).0);
14101            numbers.push(pool.add_sighted_inode(f, seen, t, Listed(snapshot)).0);
14102            numbers.push(pool.add_sighted_inode(f, seen, t, Listed(snapshot)).0);
14103            numbers.push(
14104                pool.add_sighted_inode(RawInode::new(2049, 40), seen, t, Name)
14105                    .0,
14106            );
14107            numbers
14108        };
14109        for numbered_first in [true, false] {
14110            let reused = history(f, numbered_first);
14111            assert_eq!(
14112                reused,
14113                history(fresh, numbered_first),
14114                "numbered_first={numbered_first}: host reuse changed a number"
14115            );
14116            let cached = reused[reused.len() - 3];
14117            let g = reused[reused.len() - 4];
14118            assert_ne!(cached, g, "F's cached entry took G's number");
14119            assert_eq!(
14120                cached,
14121                reused[reused.len() - 2],
14122                "the cached entry is stable"
14123            );
14124        }
14125    }

14127    /// A write through a descriptor after the last name of a never-numbered
14128    /// file went away reaches that file's history record too, so a directory
14129    /// snapshot that names it after the host reused the inode sees the same
14130    /// mtime as one that names it without reuse (claude re-check of
14131    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3849).
14132    #[test]
14133    fn a_write_after_the_last_name_reaches_the_snapshot_record() {
14134        use super::InodeSighting::Listed;
14135        use super::InodeSighting::Name;
14136        use crate::types::RawInode;
14137
14138        let t = LogicalTime::from_nanos(0);
14139        let seen = super::ObservedMtime::Unobserved;
14140        let f = RawInode::new(2049, 12);
14141        let fresh = RawInode::new(2049, 13);
14142        let cached = |g: RawInode| {
14143            let mut pool = super::InodePool::new();
14144            pool.set_mtime(f, LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_000));
14145            let snapshot = pool.retirements;
14146            pool.retire(f);
14147            pool.set_mtime(f, LogicalTime::from_nanos(2_000));
14148            pool.forget_retired(g);
14149            pool.add_sighted_inode(g, seen, t, Name);
14150            pool.add_sighted_inode(f, seen, t, Listed(snapshot))
14151        };
14152        assert_eq!(cached(f), cached(fresh));
14153        assert_eq!(cached(f).1, LogicalTime::from_nanos(2_000));
14154    }
